items.title: 伊朗：兩艘油輪在荷姆茲海峽觸雷 引發劇烈爆炸
items.title_en: Iran: Two Tankers Hit Mines in the Strait of Hormuz, Triggering Violent Explosions
paras: 伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊海軍15日（周日）宣布，過去幾小時內，兩艘在荷姆茲海峽南部海域沿未經伊朗授權航線行駛的油輪觸碰水雷，引發劇烈爆炸。
這些油輪在美軍支持下，關閉了所有識別及定位系統，試圖祕密通過海峽。
伊斯蘭革命衛隊稱，其中一艘載有超過200萬桶原油的超級油輪，在爆炸和起火後，已沉沒在波斯灣南部海域。
伊斯蘭革命衛隊建議在上述海域作業的漁民務必採取安全防範措施，避免與這些沉沒油輪的殘骸發生碰撞。
paras_en: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy announced on Sunday the 15th that within the past few hours, two tankers traveling in the southern waters of the Strait of Hormuz along a route not authorized by Iran struck naval mines, causing violent explosions.
The tankers, under U.S. support, had disabled all identification and positioning systems in an attempt to secretly transit the strait.
The IRGC said one of the vessels, a supertanker carrying more than 2 million barrels of crude oil, sank in the southern Persian Gulf after the explosion and fire.
The IRGC urged fishermen operating in the area to take safety precautions and avoid colliding with the wreckage of the sunken tankers.

items.title: Megaspeed發佈聲明！證實黃樂去年8月離職  黃仁勳緋聞牽出國安疑慮
items.title_en: Megaspeed Issues Statement Confirming Alice Huang's August 2025 Resignation; Huang Renxun Romance Sparks National‑Security Concerns
paras: 新加坡雲端運算公司 Megaspeed 周日（15日）發布聲明，證實中國籍商界人士黃樂（Alice Huang）已於2025年8月30日正式離職，目前與公司沒有任何職務關係。黃樂與輝達(NVDA-US) 前執行長黃仁勳的關係，以及她遭美方懷疑涉及中國間諜活動的傳聞，引發美國國安疑慮。
根據《路透》報導，Megaspeed 是輝達在亞太地區的商業合作夥伴。此前有報導指稱，黃仁勳曾與這名前 Megaspeed 高階主管發生婚外情，而美國當局懷疑黃艾莉是中國間諜，使該公司受到外界關注。
Megaspeed 在聲明中表示，不對黃樂的個人及私人事務發表評論。公司也強調，近期媒體報導對其業務、供應鏈及全球營運提出的部分說法，缺乏可查證的證據支持。
《紐約時報》2025年10月報導指出，Megaspeed 正接受美國政府調查，調查重點在於該公司是否協助中國客戶取得受到華府出口管制的輝達晶片。不過，中國已否認相關指控，Megaspeed 迄今也未被認定違反相關規定。
針對相關調查及報導，Megaspeed 表示，公司從事的都是合法合規的商業活動，並已聘請外部法律顧問展開全面內部調查。
公司也指出，其營運及供應鏈管控機制均以遵守適用法律與法規為設計原則，包括美國出口管制規定。
根據華府研究機構 C4ADS 檢視企業登記資料後發布的資訊，黃樂於2023年3月成為 Megaspeed 控股股東。
《路透》就 Megaspeed 的聲明向美國政府及輝達尋求評論，但雙方均未立即回覆。
paras_en: Singapore cloud‑computing firm Megaspeed issued a statement on Sunday (the 15th) confirming that Chinese businessperson Alice Huang resigned on August 30, 2025, and currently holds no position with the company. Huang's relationship with Nvidia (NVDA-US) former CEO Jensen Huang, and rumors that she is suspected by U.S. authorities of involvement in Chinese espionage, have raised U.S. national‑security concerns.

According to Reuters, Megaspeed is Nvidia’s commercial partner in the Asia‑Pacific region. Earlier reports alleged that Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair with the former Megaspeed senior executive, and U.S. officials suspect Alice Huang of being a Chinese spy, drawing external scrutiny to the firm.

In its statement, Megaspeed said it would not comment on Huang’s personal or private matters. The company also emphasized that recent media reports containing certain claims about its business, supply chain, and global operations lack verifiable evidence.

A New York Times report from October 2025 noted that Megaspeed is under investigation by the U.S. government, focusing on whether the company helped Chinese customers obtain Nvidia chips subject to U.S. export controls. China has denied the allegations, and Megaspeed has not yet been found to have violated any regulations.

Regarding the investigation and media coverage, Megaspeed said that all its activities are lawful and compliant, and that it has hired external legal counsel to conduct a comprehensive internal review.
The company also pointed out that its operational and supply‑chain control mechanisms are designed to comply with all applicable laws and regulations, including U.S. export‑control rules.
Based on information released by the Washington‑based research organization C4ADS after reviewing corporate registration data, Alice Huang became a controlling shareholder of Megaspeed in March 2023.
Reuters sought comments from the U.S. government and Nvidia on Megaspeed’s statement, but neither party responded immediately.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：AI交易關鍵時刻！輝達首份無黃仁勳財報、Anthropic重磅IPO 「川習普」三方會議登場
items.title_en: This Week's Trading Notes: Pivotal Moment for AI Trading! Nvidia’s First Earnings Without Jensen Huang, Anthropic’s Major IPO, and the “Trump‑Xi‑Putin” Trilateral Meeting
paras: 本週國際大事包括輝達第3季財報，這家人工智慧(AI)晶片巨頭將在黃仁勳閃辭執行長及股價重挫之際舉行財報電話會議，而市場高度期待的AI新創Anthropic終於要掛牌上市，這兩個重大事件將考驗AI交易能否續航。此外，美國總統川普週四將與中國國家主席習近平、俄羅斯總統普丁舉行三方會談，這將是川習兩人今年第三度面對面會晤。

1、輝達首份無黃仁勳財報

黃仁勳卸職執行長後的輝達(NVDA-US)首場財報電話會議預定週二(17日)盤後登場，將由先前擔任財務長的臨時執行長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)主持。
分析師預期，第3季營收估年增約90%至1090億美元，EPS估2.46美元。儘管市場認為這份財報仍將交出亮眼成績，但投資人更關注黃仁勳離職後的領導真空、成長預測是否有變化、AI融資承諾會否延續等問題。
分析師也好奇，輝達管理層是否會大舉實施庫藏股以支撐股價，該公司截至9月底還有2,350億美元的回購授權額度。
輝達股價上週累計下跌13%，連續第六週收黑，創2012年以來最長連跌紀錄，上週五收盤市值已跌破4兆美元。專家表示，考量到輝達目前籠罩在不確定性之中，如果財報表現不如預期，市場施加的任何懲罰都會被放大。
輝達有「AI中央銀行」之稱，大規模提供資金支持客戶擴建、資金又透過晶片採購流回輝達的「循環融資」模式，一直受到關注。華爾街日報(WSJ)報導，幾個月前，克瑞斯和黃仁勳對「循環融資」的安排有不同意見。這導致市場更加關注，輝達未來是否會繼續以大規模融資帶動晶片銷售。
專家表示，這場財報會議的考驗不只在單季數字，黃仁勳離任後，克瑞斯需要讓投資人相信，輝達仍能維持執行力、財務紀律與客戶關係，並在領導交接期間持續推進AI產品路線。

2、Anthropic上市

Anthropic(ANT-US)預定週三(18日)為首次公開發行(IPO)定價，每股估落在70-78美元，接著週四在那斯達克以代碼「ANT」掛牌交易。該公司及部分投資人計劃出售8.25億股股票，最多募資644億美元，估值最高可達1.4兆美元。
在Anthropic之前，馬斯克旗下SpaceX(SPCX-US)今年6月也曾風光IPO，當時以近1.75兆美元估值募到750億美元。但SpaceX上市後走勢顛簸，目前股價僅略高於135美元的IPO發行價，8月更曾跌到約105美元。
Madison Investments首席投資策略師Patrick Ryan表示，如果Anthropic上市後表現不佳，可能釋出另一個警訊，凸顯投資人對AI交易的壓力正在增加。
Peter Thiel家族辦公室管理合夥人Jack Selby也警告，若這樁備受期待的AI大型IPO定價遠低於市場原先預期，或掛牌後表現疲弱，可能加劇AI股修正。
值得注意的是，由於輝達已意在Anthropic IPO同步進行的私募配售中認購約100億美元股票，如今黃仁勳離任，投資人正密切觀察是否波及這項投資承諾。

3、川習普三方會議

白宮已確認，美國總統川普、中國國家主席習近平與俄羅斯總統普丁，將於週四(19日)在深圳舉行的亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)場邊舉行三方會談。這將是川習今年第三度面對面會晤。
川普計劃與習近平、普丁討論伊朗戰事，但將避開烏克蘭議題。一名白宮官員說，三方會談旨在開啟核裁軍對話，是「希望往後能有成果的對話的開端」，但不預期會宣布任何協議。分析師指出，外界對會談成果的預期偏低，象徵意義大於實質。
另外，隨著民主黨在美國期中選舉勝出，可能強化中國在貿易談判中的籌碼，也可能促使民主黨向川普施壓，要求解凍對台軍售案。
至於輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳的婚外情風波是否影響美中晶片議題，白宮官員表示，輝達的情況不應對這趟訪問造成任何影響，美國不會把出口管制的執行拿來與外國談判，川普也不打算就此事質問習近平。
白宮官員也透露，特斯拉(TSLA-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克將隨同川普前往中國深圳，出席APEC峰會。

4、Fed會議紀錄、華許主持AI小組會議

聯準會(Fed)週三將公布10月會議紀錄，Fed在該次會議上按兵不動，但近來多名Fed官員都有擔憂通膨升溫的鷹派發言，加上10月消費者物價指數(CPI)顯示通膨加速升溫，市場更加肯定12月升息的可能性，甚至開始關注明年1月是否可能連續升息。
如果Fed真的在12月和1月接連升息，將是2023年以來首次連續升息。投資人原本只預期12月與明年3月升息，但上週起已反映對12月、明年1月及3月各升息1碼的預期。
本週仍有多名Fed官員將發表演說，至於Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)，自10月決策會後記者會後便未再公開發言。他預定週一為他成立的AI與生產力工作小組主持會議，外界普遍不預期他會偏離多次表明的立場，也就是不對近期貨幣政策走向提供任何前瞻指引。

5、油價走勢

中東外交局勢預期轉變，加上美國需求降溫，正在促使國際油價下跌，但過程並不平順。
油價上週出現雙位數跌幅，已跌到每桶約90美元的兩個月低點，在北半球許多地區準備迎接寒冬之際，油價下跌可能有助於減輕政策制定者與家庭面臨的通膨壓力。
然而，近期由伊朗支持的葉門青年運動(Houthis)攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯基礎設施、運載原油駛離波灣的油輪頻繁遇襲，以及俄羅斯持續受到供應干擾，都讓市場意識到，任何新的供應中斷都可能迅速重新推升油價壓力。
paras_en: This week’s international headlines include Nvidia’s Q3 earnings, with the AI chip giant holding its earnings call as former CEO Jensen Huang steps down and the stock plummets, and the highly anticipated AI startup Anthropic finally going public. These two events will test whether AI‑driven trading can sustain its momentum. In addition, U.S. President Donald Trump will hold a trilateral meeting on Thursday with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, marking the third face‑to‑face encounter between Trump and Xi this year.
This week’s trading notes (20261116–1120)

1. Nvidia’s First Earnings Without Jensen Huang
After Jensen Huang’s resignation, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) will hold its first earnings call on Tuesday (the 17th) after market close, chaired by interim CEO and former CFO Colette Kress.

Analysts expect Q3 revenue to grow about 90% year‑over‑year to $109 billion, with EPS around $2.46. While the market believes the results will still be impressive, investors are focused on the leadership vacuum after Huang’s departure, any changes to growth forecasts, and whether AI financing commitments will continue.

Analysts are also curious whether Nvidia’s management will launch a large share‑repurchase program to support the stock; the company still has a $235 billion buyback authorization as of the end of September.

Nvidia’s share price fell 13% last week, marking a sixth consecutive week of losses—the longest streak since 2012—and its market cap slipped below $4 trillion on Friday’s close. Experts warn that, given the current uncertainty surrounding Nvidia, any earnings miss could amplify market penalties.

Nvidia is often called the “AI central bank,” providing massive financing to customers for expansion, with funds flowing back to Nvidia through chip purchases in a “circular financing” model that has drawn attention. The Wall Street Journal reported that months ago Kress and Huang disagreed over the structure of this circular financing, raising questions about whether Nvidia will continue to drive chip sales with large‑scale financing in the future.

Experts say the earnings call will test more than just quarterly numbers; after Huang’s exit, Kress must convince investors that Nvidia can maintain execution, financial discipline, and customer relationships while advancing its AI product roadmap during the leadership transition.

2. Anthropic IPO
Anthropic (ANT‑US) is slated to set its IPO price on Wednesday (the 18th) at $70‑$78 per share, then begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker “ANT” on Thursday. The company and certain investors plan to sell 825 million shares, raising up to $64.4 billion and valuing the firm at as much as $1.4 trillion.

Before Anthropic, Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX‑US) went public in June with a near‑$1.75 trillion valuation, raising $75 billion. After listing, SpaceX’s stock has been volatile, currently trading only slightly above its $135 IPO price and dipping to about $105 in August.

Madison Investments chief investment strategist Patrick Ryan warned that a weak post‑IPO performance by Anthropic could send another warning signal, highlighting growing pressure on investors in AI‑driven trading.

Jack Selby, managing partner of the Thiel family office, also cautioned that if this highly anticipated large AI IPO is priced far below market expectations or underperforms after debut, it could exacerbate a correction in AI stocks.

It is noteworthy that Nvidia intended to participate in a private placement alongside Anthropic’s IPO, committing roughly $10 billion; with Huang’s departure, investors are closely watching whether that commitment will be affected.

3. Trump‑Xi‑Putin Trilateral Meeting
The White House has confirmed that U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin will hold a three‑way meeting on Thursday (the 19th) on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen. This will be the third face‑to‑face encounter between Trump and Xi this year.

Trump plans to discuss the war in Iran with Xi and Putin but will avoid the Ukraine issue. A White House official said the talks aim to launch a nuclear‑arms‑reduction dialogue, describing it as “the start of a conversation we hope will yield results,” though no agreements are expected. Analysts note that expectations for concrete outcomes are low, with symbolic significance outweighing substance.
Additionally, with Democrats winning the U.S. midterms, China may gain leverage in trade talks, and Democrats could pressure Trump to unfreeze arms sales to Taiwan.

Regarding former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair scandal, a White House official said the matter should not affect the U.S.–China chip discussion; the U.S. will not tie export‑control enforcement to foreign negotiations, and Trump does not intend to question Xi about it.
White House officials also disclosed that Elon Musk, CEO of Tesla (TSLA‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US), will accompany Trump to Shenzhen for the APEC summit.

4. Fed Meeting Minutes and Kevin Warsh Chairs AI Working Group
The Federal Reserve will release the October meeting minutes on Wednesday. The Fed held rates steady at that meeting, but several officials have recently voiced hawkish concerns about rising inflation, and October CPI data showed accelerating price pressures, prompting the market to price in a higher likelihood of a December rate hike and even consider a possible January hike next year.

If the Fed does raise rates in both December and January, it would be the first consecutive hikes since 2023. Investors originally expected hikes in December and March 2025, but since last week have begun pricing in one‑point moves in December, January and March.

Several Fed officials will speak this week, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who has not spoken publicly since the post‑meeting press conference in October, is scheduled to chair a meeting of the AI‑and‑productivity working group on Monday. Market participants do not expect him to deviate from his previously stated stance of offering no forward guidance on monetary policy direction.

5. Oil Price Trends
Shifts in Middle‑East diplomatic dynamics, combined with cooling U.S. demand, are pushing international oil prices lower, though the decline is uneven.

Oil prices fell double‑digit percentages last week, reaching about $90 per barrel—a two‑month low—as many northern‑hemisphere regions brace for winter. The drop could help ease inflation pressures on policymakers and households.

However, recent attacks by Iran‑backed Houthi rebels on Saudi infrastructure, frequent assaults on oil tankers transporting crude from the Gulf, and ongoing supply disruptions affecting Russia have reminded markets that any new supply shock could quickly reignite upward pressure on oil prices.

items.title: 矽谷科技巨頭押注川普恐踢鐵板！OpenAI、Meta政治豪賭埋下AI產業隱憂
paras: 矽谷科技巨頭長期以擅長預測未來、掌握科技趨勢自居，但在美國政治局勢變化之際，OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）、SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克等科技領袖卻選擇公開支持美國總統川普的政策議程。隨著期中選舉結果改變政治版圖，這項押注不僅可能讓科技業面臨更大的政治風險，也讓外界開始質疑，這些自詡具有遠見的企業領袖，是否高估了自己的政治判斷力。
《MIT Technology Review》指出，科技業領袖在距離期中選舉僅剩5周時，仍聚集白宮與川普合影，並支持他的「超級智慧」（Super Intelligence）議程。
然而，當時已有數十項民調顯示，反川普情緒持續升高，且兩黨選民對人工智慧（AI）及資料中心的反對聲浪也逐漸擴大，科技巨頭卻為了爭取短期政治利益，將企業長期發展押在川普政府身上。
分析指出，這項決策如今可能帶來反效果。科技業不僅可能成為新政治局勢下的攻防目標，企業領導人的政治立場也可能成為難以擺脫的包袱。

科技業員工也不解 高層選舉後反應低調

科技業內部對高層的政治押注同樣感到困惑。曾與OpenAI、Meta(META-US) 等企業員工交流的評論者指出，選舉結果出爐後，部分科技公司高層至今沒有公開說明後續方向。
Meta執行長祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）尚未在公司內部談論選舉結果，另一家AI企業員工也表示，管理層在Slack上的發言相當有限。
員工普遍擔心，民主黨重新掌握華府政治主導權後，可能推動限制資料中心的立法，也關注企業高層將如何調整策略。不過，比起政策變化，更令部分員工不解的是，為何企業領導人沒有提前察覺政治風向可能轉變。
矽谷管理文化向來推崇冰球傳奇球星葛瑞茲基（Wayne Gretzky）的名言：「滑向冰球即將到達的位置，而不是它現在所在的位置。」這套思維強調預測趨勢、提前布局，而非被動回應眼前局勢。
科技新創也經常透過轉型調整商業模式，無法跟上時代的企業往往遭到市場淘汰。然而，評論指出，祖克柏、OpenAI共同創辦人布羅克曼（Greg Brockman），以及其他AI產業領袖和創投業者，這次卻選擇將自身與川普的政治、文化及商業議程緊密綁定，陷入可能難以脫身的政治困境。

科技巨頭放棄跨黨派布局 長期投資恐成政治攻防目標

評論表示，這場風波反映出科技業領袖並非如外界想像般無所不知。即使在社群媒體或AI領域具有深厚專業，也不代表他們同樣擅長判斷政治、經濟或其他領域的發展。
白宮接觸機會、政府補貼，以及參與自身產業監管的機會，可能讓科技業高層過度重視眼前利益，忽略美國政治權力更迭的基本規律。
相較之下，摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 、波音(BA-US) 等大型企業，通常不會將自身公開綁定特定政治陣營。這是企業長期經營累積的經驗：美國政府每4年可能更替，但企業合約及大型投資計畫往往長達10年，商業布局必須超越單一政府任期。
因此，多數企業會盡可能維持與兩黨的關係，避免政策變動直接衝擊商業模式。然而，科技巨頭這次選擇押注川普，卻可能讓旗下最重要的發展計畫，尤其是涉及電網接入及資料中心許可的大型投資，成為民主黨的優先監督與政治攻防對象。
此外，企業政治形象一旦受損，也不像軟體功能或程式碼能夠隨時修改。評論以Palantir(PLTR-US) 執行長卡普（Alex Karp）為例，指出他過去一年不斷發表強硬言論，並向投資人強調公司「完全反覺醒」，未來是否還能突然轉向進步派立場，恐怕難以取信於外界。
一名曾與祖克柏密切共事的Meta員工也形容，祖克柏雖然擅長長期思考，卻未必有明確的實現路徑，決策方式更像是廣泛嘗試、寄望成功，再觀察後續發展。該員工並指出，Facebook過去也很少針對重大策略失誤進行完整檢討。

AI競賽政治化 損害產業爭取基礎建設的籌碼

評論認為，科技業這次最大的失誤，是將AI產業發展捲入美國文化及政治戰線。過去光纖技術與無線通訊基礎建設等重大科技發展，並未成為明顯的黨派政治議題，但矽谷對川普政府的靠攏，卻讓AI逐漸成為文化戰爭的一部分。
如今，從加州到佛羅里達州，民眾在表決資料中心建設提案時，考量的已不只是技術或經濟效益，還包括企業與政治陣營的關係。
分析指出，對急於在AI競賽中取得領先地位的科技巨頭而言，這種政治風險尤其值得警惕。企業領袖過度聚焦AI競爭的迫切性，卻低估公眾信任與企業聲譽受損後，可能對產業發展造成的衝擊。
資料中心、電力供應及相關基礎建設，都是AI產業持續擴張的重要條件，而這些投資同樣需要地方政府與民眾支持。當科技企業失去原本的社會信任，即使掌握領先技術，也可能難以取得推動產業發展所需的資源與許可。
這場政治押注已經動搖矽谷長期以來的一項核心形象：科技領袖總能比其他人更早看見未來。

items.title: 伊朗利用美國士兵跑步App蒐集情報 炸出90億美元損失
items.title_en: Iran Used U.S. Soldiers' Running App to Gather Intelligence, Causing $9 Billion in Losses
paras: 美軍擁有全球最先進的衛星、雷達和情報系統，卻可能被士兵手機裡的跑步軟體出賣。
美國《洛杉磯時報》14日（周六）發表調查，指出在今年爆發的美伊戰爭中，伊朗通過蒐集美軍人員的社交媒體、健身App和商業廣告數據，結合據稱來自俄羅斯的衛星圖像，分析美軍基地人員活動規律，為飛彈和無人機襲擊提供情報支援。
這場情報戰的後果相當嚴重。
根據《美聯社》10月31日公布的衛星圖像調查，截至今年8月，伊朗及其支持的武裝在中東26處美軍基地和相關設施發動的襲擊中，至少有115次造成建築或設施損壞。遭襲目標包括雷達、機場跑道、機庫、通訊設備和人員營房。
《洛杉磯時報》援引的估算顯示，僅修復這些基地的基礎設施就可能耗資約90億美元，尚不包括飛機、先進雷達等軍事裝備的損失。
一款跑步軟體，如何暴露軍事祕密？
伊朗獲取情報的方式，可能比傳統間諜活動簡單得多。
今年8月，英國《Sky News》的調查發現，超過1,300名Strava健身App用戶在中東美軍基地分享運動紀錄，涉及數千次跑步、騎行等活動。
這些紀錄不僅包含運動路線，還包括具體時間，甚至能夠反映軍事人員的日常活動、部隊調動和撤離情況。
令人驚訝的是，美軍早在2018年就已警告，這類App可能暴露軍事行動，但八年之後，類似問題仍然存在。
洩密渠道甚至不限於軍人自己發布的內容。
在巴林的美國海軍支援基地，Google地圖上的公開訊息能夠顯示保齡球館、健身房、餐廳等設施的位置，用戶評論中甚至包含健身房開放時間。
對軍事情報人員而言，長期積累的這些零散訊息，可以幫助判斷基地內部不同區域的用途及人員活動規律。
paras_en: The U.S. military possesses the world’s most advanced satellites, radars and intelligence systems, yet it may be betrayed by a running app on soldiers’ phones.

The Los Angeles Times published an investigation on Saturday, the 14th, indicating that in the Iran‑U.S. war that erupted this year, Iran collected U.S. service members’ social‑media, fitness‑app and commercial‑advertising data, combined with satellite imagery allegedly from Russia, to analyze patterns of activity at U.S. bases and provide intelligence support for missile and drone attacks.
The consequences of this intelligence battle are severe.

According to a satellite‑imagery investigation released by the Associated Press on Oct. 31, attacks by Iran and its proxy forces on 26 U.S. bases and related facilities in the Middle East through August this year resulted in at least 115 incidents that damaged buildings or infrastructure. Targets hit included radars, airfield runways, hangars, communications gear and personnel barracks.

The Los Angeles Times cited estimates that merely repairing the infrastructure at these bases could cost roughly $9 billion, not counting losses of aircraft, advanced radars and other military equipment.
How can a running app expose military secrets?
Iran’s method of obtaining intelligence may be far simpler than traditional espionage.

In August, a Sky News investigation found that more than 1,300 Strava fitness‑app users posted workout records from U.S. bases in the Middle East, covering thousands of runs, rides and other activities.
These records include not only the routes but also precise timestamps, which can reveal daily routines of military personnel, unit movements and evacuations.
Surprisingly, the U.S. military warned as early as 2018 that such apps could expose operations, yet the problem persists eight years later.
The leak channels are not limited to content posted by service members themselves.

At a U.S. Navy support base in Bahrain, publicly available information on Google Maps shows the locations of bowling alleys, gyms, restaurants and other facilities, with user reviews even listing gym opening hours.
For intelligence analysts, the long‑term accumulation of these scattered bits of data can help determine the functions of different areas within a base and the patterns of personnel activity.

items.title: OpenAI測試ChatGPT商家功能！導入AI導購代理  商家可上架商品、掌握推薦流量
items.title_en: OpenAI Tests ChatGPT Merchant Feature! Introducing AI Shopping Agent; Merchants Can List Products and Track Recommendation Traffic
paras: 生成式人工智慧（AI）競爭延伸至電商領域。OpenAI近日宣布，開始測試ChatGPT商家功能，讓通過驗證的美國商家認領品牌頁面、提交商品價格與庫存目錄，並導入商家AI代理，直接在ChatGPT內回答消費者的商品問題，將AI對話轉化為購物入口。
這項測試也提供品牌導購與商家代理功能。商家可在後台更新商品資訊，讓AI代理掌握產品內容，依據消費者需求提供回答；消費者則能從ChatGPT的商品推薦進入商家頁面，與品牌專屬AI代理展開獨立對話，進一步詢問產品功效。
當消費者決定購買時，AI會提供商家官方網站連結，引導消費者完成交易。
商家也能透過後台查看過去28天內被ChatGPT提及的次數及商品點擊量等數據，掌握品牌在AI對話中的曝光情況。
這並非ChatGPT首次涉足電商交易。去年9月，美國用戶已可透過ChatGPT對話直接購買Etsy(ETSY-US) 商品；此次推出的商家測試，則進一步讓品牌能管理自己的商品資訊，並透過AI代理與潛在買家互動。
AI逐漸成為消費者搜尋商品與評估購買選項的管道。Adobe(ADBE-US) 今年9月針對美國零售網站的數據顯示，來自AI工具的網站點擊量年增71%；而在已進入零售網站的訪客中，AI來源流量的購買轉換率比非AI來源高出90%。
大型零售與科技業者也陸續布局AI購物服務。美妝零售商 Sephora 今年3月已在ChatGPT推出品牌應用程式，讓消費者透過對話取得符合自身膚質的化妝品推薦；若連結會員帳號，系統還能參考個人偏好提供商品建議。
沃爾瑪(WMT-US) 則更早將購物服務整合至ChatGPT，讓消費者能直接在對話中選購商品，並使用沃爾瑪會員權益與支付方式。
沃爾瑪曾指出，零售服務正從被動回應轉向主動提供協助，業者需要運用AI掌握消費者需求，在顧客提出問題前就提供適當推薦。
除了ChatGPT，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 與Google(GOOGL-US) 也在擴大AI購物功能。亞馬遜近期邀請部分美國用戶測試Alexa簡訊購物服務，未來幾周計畫向數百萬用戶開放。消費者可傳送食譜照片，讓Alexa辨識所需食材並加入購物車，也能依照指示直接下單。
Google則已開始在加拿大推出直接結帳功能。消費者透過搜尋引擎的AI模式或Gemini比較商品時，符合條件的商品可直接進行結帳。
隨著消費者逐漸習慣在購物前先向AI詢問商品資訊，AI平台也開始從資訊搜尋延伸至商品推薦與交易環節。對商家而言，ChatGPT等工具不只是新的導購服務，也可能成為接觸潛在客戶的流量入口。
當消費者透過AI比較商品時，能否進入最初的推薦清單，可能影響後續取得訂單的機會。隨著電商與AI服務持續整合，商家如何管理商品資料、提高在AI推薦中的能見度，也將成為新的競爭課題。
paras_en: Generative AI competition is extending into e‑commerce. OpenAI announced it is now testing a ChatGPT merchant feature that lets verified U.S. merchants claim brand pages, submit product price and inventory catalogs, and deploy a merchant AI agent to answer consumer product questions directly within ChatGPT, turning AI dialogue into a shopping gateway.

The test also provides brand‑shopping and merchant‑agent capabilities. Merchants can update product information in a backend so the AI agent knows the product details and can answer based on consumer needs; consumers can follow product recommendations from ChatGPT to a merchant page and start a separate conversation with the brand‑specific AI agent to ask about product benefits.
When a consumer decides to buy, the AI supplies a link to the merchant’s official website, guiding the consumer to complete the transaction.
Merchants can also view data in the backend showing how many times their brand was mentioned by ChatGPT and product click‑throughs over the past 28 days, giving insight into AI‑driven exposure.

This is not ChatGPT’s first foray into e‑commerce. In September last year, U.S. users could already purchase Etsy (ETSY‑US) items through a ChatGPT conversation; the new merchant test further lets brands manage their own product information and interact with potential buyers via an AI agent.

AI is increasingly becoming a channel for consumers to search for products and evaluate purchase options. Adobe (ADBE‑US) reported in September that AI‑driven website clicks for U.S. retail sites grew 71% year‑over‑year, and among visitors who reached retail sites, the purchase conversion rate from AI traffic was 90% higher than non‑AI traffic.

Large retailers and tech firms are also rolling out AI shopping services. Beauty retailer Sephora launched a brand app on ChatGPT in March, allowing consumers to get makeup recommendations suited to their skin type through conversation; linking a loyalty account lets the system also factor personal preferences into product suggestions.
Walmart (WMT‑US) integrated shopping services into ChatGPT even earlier, enabling consumers to select and purchase items directly in the chat and use Walmart membership benefits and payment methods.

Walmart has said retail services are shifting from passive response to proactive assistance, and operators need to use AI to anticipate consumer needs and provide appropriate recommendations before a question is asked.

Beyond ChatGPT, Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Google (GOOGL‑US) are expanding AI shopping features. Amazon recently invited a subset of U.S. users to test an Alexa text‑shopping service and plans to roll it out to millions in the coming weeks; users can send a recipe photo, have Alexa identify needed ingredients, add them to a cart, and place orders by voice.
Google has begun rolling out a direct checkout feature in Canada. When consumers compare products via the search engine’s AI mode or Gemini, qualifying items can be checked out directly.

As consumers grow accustomed to asking AI for product information before buying, AI platforms are moving from information search to recommendation and transaction stages. For merchants, tools like ChatGPT are not just new referral services but could become traffic entry points to reach potential customers.

When consumers compare products through AI, whether a brand appears in the initial recommendation list can affect its chances of securing orders. As e‑commerce and AI services continue to merge, how merchants manage product data and boost visibility in AI recommendations will become a fresh competitive challenge.

items.title: 誰能駕馭這頭巨獸？哈佛教授：黃仁勳辭職後  輝達面臨「20年最難接班」問題
items.title_en: Who Can Tame This Beast? Harvard Professor Says Nvidia Faces Its Most Difficult Succession in 20 Years After Jensen Huang’s Resignation
paras: 輝達創辦人黃仁勳上周突宣布辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效，結束其長達33年的掌舵生涯。這位長期自詡「無可替代」的創辦人離去，令這家全球最具價值的AI晶片巨頭瞬間陷入接班真空。
黃仁勳歷來採取高度集權的扁平化管理，擁有約60名直屬部屬，決策權高度集中於一身；英偉達董事會過去甚至未設董事長職位，無人能制衡其決定。
黃仁勳親自建立並維繫公司最重要的外部人脈，從拉攏美國總統川普，到與台積電創辦人張忠謀維持密切關係，為輝達取得稀缺產能優先權。
憑藉個人直覺，黃仁勳帶領公司在AI等領域做出大膽早期押注，將輝達打造成全球最具價值企業之一。
據悉，黃仁勳雖保持低調，但仍參與繼任過程，並已與至少一名潛在候選人通話。
然而，尋找繼任者難度極高。哈佛商學院教授Andy Wu直言，這是「至少10到20年來最難填補的執行長職位」。他指出，AI投資本質上要求承擔風險，這類看似非理性的押注，需要一位具備創辦人同等掌控力與感召力的領導者，才能在投資者面前保持靈活溝通，並激勵員工執行外界眼中「近乎荒謬」的遠景。
目前，輝達財務長柯蕾絲(Colette Kress)已出任臨時執行長，董事會同步啟動正式執行長遴選，內外部人選均納入考量。這家與黃仁勳個人願景、魅力深度交織的企業，正式邁入未知的「後黃仁勳時代」。
paras_en: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang abruptly announced last week that he is stepping down from his roles as president, chief executive officer and director, effective immediately, ending a 33‑year reign. The long‑time self‑described “irreplaceable” founder’s departure leaves the world’s most valuable AI‑chip giant suddenly facing a leadership vacuum.

Huang has always run a highly centralized, flat organization, with about 60 direct reports and decision‑making power concentrated in his hands; Nvidia’s board historically did not even have a chairman, leaving no one to check his decisions.

Huang personally built and maintained the company’s most important external relationships, from courting former U.S. President Donald Trump to keeping close ties with TSMC founder Morris Chang, securing priority access to scarce manufacturing capacity for Nvidia.
Relying on his own intuition, Huang led the company to make bold early bets in AI and other fields, turning Nvidia into one of the world’s most valuable enterprises.
Sources say that although Huang is keeping a low profile, he is still involved in the succession process and has already spoken with at least one potential candidate.

Finding a successor, however, is extremely difficult. Harvard Business School professor Andy Wu bluntly called it “the hardest CEO role to fill in at least the past 10 to 20 years.” He noted that AI investment inherently involves risk and that such seemingly irrational bets require a leader with founder‑level control and charisma to communicate flexibly with investors and inspire employees to pursue visions that outsiders might deem almost absurd.

For now, Nvidia’s chief financial officer Colette Kress has stepped in as interim CEO, and the board has launched a formal search for a permanent chief executive, considering both internal and external candidates. The company, whose identity is deeply intertwined with Huang’s personal vision and charisma, is now officially entering an unknown “post‑Huang” era.

items.title: 黃仁勳辭任獲矽谷大咖聲援！馬斯克、Gavin Baker、Epic Games執行長批輝達董事會
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Resigns, Receives Backing from Silicon Valley Heavyweights: Musk, Gavin Baker, and Epic Games CEO Criticize Nvidia Board
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳辭職後，矽谷多名企業領袖與投資人接連公開表態支持，認為黃仁勳是公司難以取代的核心人物，若他離開，恐動搖輝達與人工智慧（AI）產業之間的合作關係，甚至影響美國在AI競賽中的地位。
根據《紐約時報》報導，黃仁勳上周四（12日）辭去輝達執行長職務，此前傳出他與一名公司員工及一名中國女性有染。消息曝光後，多名科技業高層、投資人及新創企業領袖透過社群平台發文或致函董事會，要求重新考慮黃仁勳的去留，並質疑董事會是否迫於外界壓力做出決定。
SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長、全球首富馬斯克周六（14日）在社群平台表示，黃仁勳在輝達供應鏈管理方面表現出色，許多交易仰賴雙方握手達成，而非正式書面合約。
他直言，少了黃仁勳，至少部分關鍵交易可能無法延續。
Altimeter Capital Management執行長Brad Gerstner與Atreides Management首席投資長Gavin Baker周五（13日）亦致函輝達董事會，指出倉促更換黃仁勳並不符合股東最大利益，要求董事會考慮所有可能選項，包括讓黃仁勳重新出任執行長。
另一封名為《與黃仁勳站在一起》的公開信，則直接要求輝達董事會重新任命黃仁勳為執行長、展開獨立調查，並對相關事件作出說明。
截至周六（14日）上午，該信已獲得近10萬人簽署，支持者包括輝達現任與前任員工、馬斯克等商業夥伴，以及創投公司Y Combinator執行長Garry Tan等新創業界人士與股東。
這波聲援也凸顯黃仁勳在AI產業中的影響力。輝達從早期生產電玩用晶片起家，如今已掌握美國大型AI計畫所使用的先進晶片市場90%。隨著公司成長為全球市值最高的企業之一，黃仁勳也成為矽谷重要的交易推手，協助需要晶片與資金的新創企業建立合作關係。
部分企業領袖對輝達董事會的批評更為直接。通訊應用程式Telegram執行長杜羅夫（Pavel Durov）周五在社群平台發文，認為黃仁勳犯下新手錯誤，並藉此提醒創辦人應掌握董事會主導權。
電玩公司Epic Games執行長史威尼（Tim Sweeney）周四則批評輝達董事會存在嚴重的公司治理問題。他在黃仁勳辭職前一天曾表示，如果董事會撤換黃仁勳，將是如同蘋果(AAPL-US) 當年解雇賈伯斯般愚蠢的決定。
1985年，蘋果董事會曾罷免共同創辦人賈伯斯（Steve Jobs），直到1997年他才重返公司，再度出任執行長。
創投家Elad Gil也在周四發文指出，黃仁勳辭職為所有創辦人敲響警鐘，應重新檢視董事會成員組成。他建議創辦人應趁公司順利時調整董事會，以免在情勢不利時遭遇突如其來的變動。
Uber (UBER-US) 共同創辦人、前執行長卡蘭尼克（Travis Kalanick）的經歷，也成為外界討論的案例。2017年，優步面臨日益嚴重的法律與道德爭議，公司最大投資人要求卡蘭尼克辭職；他離開執行長職位後，便未再回到優步。
paras_en: After Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, numerous Silicon Valley business leaders and investors publicly voiced support, saying Huang is an irreplaceable core figure for the company and that his departure could jeopardize Nvidia's collaborations with the artificial intelligence (AI) industry and even affect the United States' standing in the AI race.

According to the New York Times, Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO last Thursday (the 12th) following rumors of an affair with a company employee and a Chinese woman. After the story broke, many tech executives, investors and startup leaders posted on social media or wrote letters to the board urging a reconsideration of Huang's exit and questioning whether the board yielded to external pressure.

SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO and world’s richest man Elon Musk posted on social media on Saturday (the 14th) that Huang excelled at managing Nvidia’s supply chain, noting that many deals rely on a handshake between the parties rather than formal written contracts.
He stated plainly that without Huang, at least some key transactions might not be able to continue.

Altimeter Capital Management CEO Brad Gerstner and Atreides Management chief investment officer Gavin Baker also wrote to Nvidia’s board on Friday (the 13th), arguing that a rushed replacement of Huang does not serve shareholders’ best interests and urging the board to consider all options, including reinstating Huang as CEO.
Another open letter titled “Standing with Jensen Huang” directly called on Nvidia’s board to re‑appoint Huang as CEO, launch an independent investigation, and provide an explanation of the incident.

By Saturday morning (the 14th), the letter had been signed by nearly 100,000 people, including current and former Nvidia employees, business partners such as Musk, and startup community figures and shareholders like Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan.

The wave of support also highlights Huang’s influence in the AI sector. Nvidia, which began by making chips for video games, now controls about 90% of the advanced chip market used in large U.S. AI projects. As the company has grown into one of the world’s most valuable firms, Huang has become a key deal‑maker in Silicon Valley, helping chip‑ and capital‑hungry startups forge partnerships.

Some business leaders were more blunt in their criticism of Nvidia’s board. Telegram founder Pavel Durov posted on social media on Friday, saying Huang made a rookie mistake and using the episode to remind founders to retain control over their boards.

Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney criticized Nvidia’s board on Thursday, saying it suffers from serious corporate‑governance problems. He had warned the day before Huang’s resignation that removing him would be as foolish as Apple (AAPL-US) firing Steve Jobs.
In 1985 Apple’s board ousted co‑founder Steve Jobs, who did not return to the company until 1997, when he was reinstated as CEO.

Venture capitalist Elad Gil also posted on Thursday that Huang’s resignation should sound an alarm for all founders, urging a review of board composition. He suggested founders adjust their boards while the company is thriving to avoid sudden upheavals when conditions turn adverse.

The experience of Uber (UBER-US) co‑founder and former CEO Travis Kalanick is also being cited. In 2017 Uber faced mounting legal and ethical controversies, and its largest investor demanded Kalanick’s resignation; after stepping down as CEO he never returned to the company.

items.title: 新光人壽副董洪士琪化身「匹克球隊長」助威 「第一屆新光認真盃公開賽」創金融業首例
items.title_en: Shin Kong Life Deputy Director Hong Shiqi Becomes “Pickleball Captain” to Cheer on the Inaugural “Shin Kong Serious Cup” Public Tournament, a First in the Financial Industry
paras: 台新新光金控(2887-TW)子公司新光人壽主辦的「第一屆新光認真盃匹克球公開賽」於11月14日至11月15日在國立台北教育大學火熱展開。這場賽事從規劃、推動到落地，背後重要推手正是新光人壽副董事長洪士琪，因看見匹克球兼具趣味、健康及全民樂齡參與的特性，親自號召同仁投入賽事籌辦，促成「新光認真盃」的誕生。賽事現場不只有選手們你來我往的激烈對戰，也安排集團吉祥物Richart與可愛動物人偶卡皮巴拉來場「萌力對決」，洪士琪更在賽事期間化身「匹克球隊長」為選手們加油打氣，與球友一同感受匹克球的熱情與魅力。
「新光認真盃匹克球公開賽」依DUPR分級制度規劃新手組、初階組及中階組，各級別均設有男子雙打、女子雙打及混合雙打項目，並邀請知名職業選手、曾獲匹克球世界盃單打冠軍金牌的蔡萱擔任賽事顧問，共吸引超過百位球友組隊參賽，現場選手還可獲得一份「匹克球拍造型立體悠遊卡」，為首屆賽事留下專屬紀念。

匹克球越來越受到大眾歡迎的原因，也在於它沒有一定的年齡限制。洪士琪表示，此次賽事現場可見不同世代的球友同場較勁，從年輕選手到60、70歲的銀髮球友，都能在球場上找到屬於自己的「勝利方程式」；再加上比賽中邀請日前在國內外社群媒體上爆紅的「小曹」卡皮巴拉布偶進行開場表演，並規劃與Richart趣味登場對打，讓球場上既有緊張刺激的競賽，也充滿可愛逗趣的互動橋段，最終首屆賽事就在選手們一次次認真揮拍、精彩擊球與歡呼歡笑聲中畫下完美句點。
由於賽事開放報名後不到兩天即全數額滿，熱烈程度遠超預期，也讓不少有心參賽的球友來不及搶到名額。對於這次沒能順利參與首屆賽事的球友，新光人壽承諾明年將擴大舉辦規模，盼能讓更多喜愛匹克球的民眾有機會站上球場，好好享受運動與競技的樂趣。
新光人壽作為國內首家舉行大型匹克球公開賽事的企業，這場賽事的誕生，源自於「希望讓更多人一起認真動起來」的發想。洪士琪看見匹克球好上手、趣味性高，又能跨越年齡與世代一起同樂，隨著近年越來越多大小朋友開始接觸這項運動，也因此希望新光人壽能自辦一場從小孩、上班族到銀髮長者，都能享受揮拍與交流樂趣的活動，逐步萌生舉辦匹克球賽事的念頭。
新光人壽對於推廣運動的熱情，在企業內早已從上到下已蔚然成風，包括董事長魏寶生擔任「新光足球學校校長」，陪伴足球運動向下扎根；總經理黃敏義熱愛街舞，不但為國內歷史最悠久的新光盃熱門街舞大賽引進日本師資，更有「金融圈最懂街舞的總經理」之稱。從經營團隊到員工，新光人壽以不同方式投入運動，也讓推廣全民、全齡健康內化為企業文化的一環。

新光人壽致力落實ESG永續經營，也秉持著台新新光金控「認真、創新、永續」的企業精神，長期推廣運動不遺餘力，回應超高齡社會下全民健康促進的多元需求，將「認真」化為一場場實際行動，持續拓展更多元的全齡健康促進活動。如陪伴孩子踏上球場的「小小足球嘉年華」、串聯全台的「Fun Run」，再到深受年輕世代喜愛的街舞、電競賽事，以及結合腦力與手速挑戰的魔術方塊大賽」，如今更加入近年快速風靡、適合跨世代同樂的匹克球，未來也將持續擴大舉辦，期盼結合健康生態圈，鼓勵民眾投入自主健康管理、享受運動，讓健康生活陪伴大眾成長茁壯。
paras_en: Shin Kong Life Insurance, a subsidiary of Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding (2887‑TW), hosted the inaugural "Shin Kong Serious Cup Pickleball Open" from November 14 to 15 at National Taipei University of Education. The event was driven by Shin Kong Life Deputy Chairman Hong Shiqi, who, recognizing pickleball’s fun, health‑benefiting and all‑ages appeal, personally rallied colleagues to organize the tournament and bring the "Shin Kong Serious Cup" to life. The venue featured not only intense matches but also a playful showdown between the group mascot Richart and a cute capybara mascot, while Hong transformed into a "Pickleball Captain" during the event to cheer on players and share the sport’s passion and charm.

The "Shin Kong Serious Cup Pickleball Open" was structured according to the DUPR rating system with beginner, intermediate and advanced divisions, each offering men’s doubles, women’s doubles and mixed doubles. Noted professional player and former World Cup singles champion Cai Xuan served as a tournament advisor, attracting over a hundred participants who formed teams. Competitors also received a three‑dimensional “pickleball‑shaped EasyCard” as a souvenir of the inaugural event.

Pickleball’s growing popularity stems from its lack of age restrictions. Hong noted that the tournament showcased players from different generations competing side by side, from young athletes to silver‑hair participants in their 60s and 70s, each finding their own “winning formula.” The event also featured a debut performance by the viral “Little Cao” capybara plush and a fun showdown with Richart, blending intense competition with cute, entertaining interactions, and concluding with enthusiastic rallies, cheers and laughter.

Registrations filled up within two days of opening, far exceeding expectations and leaving many hopeful players unable to secure a spot. Shin Kong Life pledged to expand the tournament next year, aiming to give more pickleball enthusiasts the chance to step onto the court and enjoy the sport and competition.

As the first domestic company to host a large‑scale pickleball open, Shin Kong Life conceived the event from the idea of “encouraging more people to get seriously active.” Hong saw pickleball’s easy learning curve, high fun factor and cross‑generational appeal, and, as more children, office workers and seniors take up the sport, envisioned an event where participants of all ages could enjoy swinging paddles and socializing, sparking the notion to organize a pickleball tournament.

Shin Kong Life’s enthusiasm for promoting sports permeates the company culture, from top to bottom. Chairman Wei Baosheng serves as “principal” of the Shin Kong Football School, fostering grassroots football; General Manager Huang Minyi, a street‑dance enthusiast, has brought Japanese instructors to the historic Shin Kong Cup street‑dance competition, earning the nickname “the most street‑dance‑savvy GM in finance.” Employees at all levels engage in sports, embedding universal, all‑age health promotion into the corporate ethos.

Committed to ESG sustainability and guided by Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding’s spirit of “seriousness, innovation, sustainability,” Shin Kong Life continuously promotes sports to meet the diverse health needs of an aging society. Initiatives range from the “Little Soccer Carnival” for children, nationwide “Fun Run,” popular street‑dance and e‑sports events, to a Rubik’s Cube challenge, now adding the fast‑growing, cross‑generational pickleball. Future plans include expanding such activities, integrating health ecosystems, encouraging self‑managed health and making active living a companion to everyone’s growth.

items.title: 華電網Q4進入專案認列高峰期 營運可望更上層樓
items.title_en: HuaDianNet Enters Project Recognition Peak in Q4, Operations Expected to Rise Further
paras: 資通訊服務整合商華電網(6163-TW)第三季擺脫虧損重返獲利軌道，每股純益0.46元；展望第四季，公司看好，進入年度專案認列高峰期，加上客戶需求旺盛，營運可望再上層樓。
華電網第三季營收21.72億元，季增80.06%、年增32.47%、毛利率18.32%，季減1.78個百分點、年減0.50個百分點、營業利益0.97億元，較上季轉盈、年增113.14%，營業利益率4.45%，季增7.17個百分點；稅後純益0.69億元，較上季轉盈、年增120.10%，每股純益0.46元。
華電網前三季累計營收52.02億元，年增34.73%、毛利率17.83%，年減2.47個百分點、營業利益0.69億元，較去年同期轉盈、營業利益率1.32%，稅後純益0.42億元。華電網10 月營收13.64 億元，年增289.72%。累計前 10 月營收為 65.66 億元，年增 55.91%。
營運長王榮德表示，公司在智慧交通、電信寬頻網路、企業資安維運保持領先，今年更透過成立子公司碩維回應半導體業客戶對客製化網路與算力的需求，並與母公司專案團隊技術對接可望加速產品化進程，爭取更多高毛利的長約。
技術布局上，華電網不僅協助客戶建置大規模AI 資料中心，導入雲端大型語言模型（LLM），也持續強化地端（On-Premise）與私有環境的部署能力，依據資料敏感度、法規遵循、資安治理及營運需求，規劃最合適的AI架構。
王榮德指出，未來透過母公司大型專案承攬能力、加上子公司敏捷創新的雙引擎模式，讓集團持續從傳統系統整合商轉型為全方位的人工智慧生態系賦能者。
paras_en: Integrated ICT services provider HuaDianNet (6163‑TW) turned around from a loss in Q3 to profitability, posting earnings per share of NT$0.46. Looking ahead to Q4, the company is optimistic, entering the annual peak period for project recognition and, coupled with strong customer demand, expects operations to climb higher.

In Q3, HuaDianNet recorded revenue of NT$2.172 billion, up 80.06% quarter‑over‑quarter and 32.47% year‑over‑year, with a gross margin of 18.32% (down 1.78 percentage points QoQ and 0.50 points YoY). Operating profit was NT$97 million, turning positive from the prior quarter and up 113.14% YoY, yielding an operating margin of 4.45% (up 7.17 points QoQ). Net profit after tax was NT$69 million, also turning positive from the prior quarter and up 120.10% YoY, translating to earnings per share of NT$0.46.

For the first three quarters, cumulative revenue reached NT$5.202 billion, a 34.73% YoY increase, with a gross margin of 17.83% (down 2.47 points YoY). Operating profit was NT$69 million, a turnaround from the same period last year, with an operating margin of 1.32%, and net profit after tax was NT$42 million. In October, revenue was NT$1.364 billion, up 289.72% YoY. Cumulative revenue through October totaled NT$6.566 billion, a 55.91% YoY rise.

Chief Operating Officer Wang Rong‑de said the company maintains leadership in smart transportation, telecom broadband networks, and enterprise cybersecurity operations. This year, it responded to semiconductor customers' demand for customized networking and computing power by establishing the subsidiary ShuoWei, and by linking its technology with the parent company's project teams to accelerate productization and secure more high‑margin long‑term contracts.

On the technology front, HuaDianNet not only assists clients in building large‑scale AI data centers and deploying cloud‑based large language models (LLMs), but also continuously strengthens on‑premise and private‑environment deployment capabilities. It tailors the optimal AI architecture based on data sensitivity, regulatory compliance, security governance, and operational needs.

Wang Rong‑de noted that moving forward, the group will leverage the parent company's large‑scale project execution capability together with the subsidiary's agile innovation, forming a dual‑engine model that will transform the conglomerate from a traditional systems integrator into a comprehensive AI ecosystem enabler.

items.title: 亞資助攻資本市場躍升！2026公司治理評鑑台灣、新加坡並列亞洲第3
items.title_en: Asian Capital Market Boosted by Taiwanese Support! 2026 Corporate Governance Rankings Taiwan and Singapore Tie for 3rd in Asia
paras: 台灣公司治理再獲國際權威機構肯定，CG Watch 2026評鑑結果顯示，台灣在亞洲12個主要市場中再度與新加坡並列第三，僅次於澳洲與日本，整體得分較上屆增加4.6分。其中以投資人構面進步最為顯著，充分反映出台灣資本市場近年來在強化股東權益保障、推動環境社會與治理資訊揭露透明化等面向的卓著成效，讓國際社會看見台灣企業的強大韌性與治理實力。
亞洲公司治理協會於11月初在台北盛大舉辦年度盛會，吸引各國代表與專家學者齊聚一堂。本次年會以持續亞洲的改革動能為主題，深入探討日韓台企業價值提升計畫、地緣經濟風險與戰略韌性、人工智慧與數位科技對公司治理的重塑，以及少數股東權益與投資人盡職治理等核心議題，透過多方深入交流，大幅提升台灣資本市場在國際舞台上的能見度與影響力。
行政院長卓榮泰與相關部會積極推動國家經濟與資本市場發展，櫃買中心也強調將持續配合主管機關上市櫃公司永續發展行動方案及打造台灣成為亞洲資產管理中心之政策規劃。未來將積極協助上櫃公司提升資訊透明度、強化獨立董事職能，並透過環境社會與治理評鑑引領企業落實永續發展，持續扮演陪跑者角色，奠定台灣資本市場的堅實根基。
隨著亞洲資產管理中心政策的逐步推動，台灣資本市場的國際化腳步正在全面加快。本次CG Watch評鑑的優異表現，不僅證明我國在公司治理改革上的方向正確，更吸引了外資與國際機構的目光。法人指出，台灣企業在落實ESG與資訊透明度上的努力已見成效，未來若能持續深化投資人權益保障，將有助於吸引更多長期資金匯聚，進一步鞏固台灣在亞太金融市場中的關鍵戰略地位。
展望未來，在政府政策強力引導與各界共同努力下，台灣資本市場正迎來轉型升級的關鍵時刻。櫃買中心與相關周邊單位將持續精進各項規範，協助企業因應地緣政治與數位科技帶來的挑戰。透過全方位的陪跑機制與永續發展行動方案，台灣企業不僅要在公司治理評鑑中維持領先優勢，更要以高標準的透明度與信任感，攜手迎向全球資本市場的新賽局。
paras_en: Taiwan's corporate governance has once again been recognized by an international authority. The CG Watch 2026 assessment shows Taiwan ranking jointly third with Singapore among the 12 major Asian markets, behind only Australia and Japan, with an overall score 4.6 points higher than the previous edition. The most notable improvement was in the investor dimension, reflecting the strong results of Taiwan's capital market in recent years in strengthening shareholder rights protection and promoting transparency of environmental, social and governance disclosures, showcasing the resilience and governance strength of Taiwanese firms to the international community.

The Asian Corporate Governance Association held its annual conference in early November in Taipei, drawing representatives and experts from various countries. The meeting, themed on sustaining Asia's reform momentum, delved into topics such as value‑enhancement plans for Japanese, Korean and Taiwanese firms, geopolitical risk and strategic resilience, the reshaping of corporate governance by AI and digital technology, and minority shareholder rights and investor due‑diligence governance. Through extensive dialogue, the event markedly raised the visibility and influence of Taiwan's capital market on the global stage.

Premier Zhu Rongtai and relevant ministries are actively promoting national economic and capital market development, and the OTC (Over‑The‑Counter) market centre emphasized its continued alignment with regulators on sustainability action plans for listed companies and policies to make Taiwan an Asian asset‑management hub. Going forward, it will help listed companies improve information transparency, strengthen the role of independent directors, and use ESG assessments to guide firms toward sustainable development, continuing its supportive role and solidifying the foundation of Taiwan's capital market.

As the Asian asset‑management hub policy advances, Taiwan's market internationalization is accelerating across the board. The strong performance in this CG Watch assessment not only confirms that the country's corporate‑governance reform direction is correct, but also draws attention from foreign investors and international institutions. Institutional investors note that Taiwanese firms' efforts in ESG implementation and information transparency are bearing fruit, and that further deepening of investor‑rights protection will help attract more long‑term capital, further cementing Taiwan's strategic position in the Asia‑Pacific financial market.

Looking ahead, with strong government guidance and joint efforts from all sectors, Taiwan's capital market is entering a pivotal transformation phase. The OTC market centre and related bodies will keep refining regulations to help companies navigate geopolitical and digital‑technology challenges. Through comprehensive support mechanisms and sustainability action plans, Taiwanese firms aim not only to maintain their leading edge in governance assessments but also to uphold high standards of transparency and trust, partnering to face the new global capital‑market landscape.

items.title: 〈觀察〉三大台系PCB廠前3季汽車板銷售都突破百億元健鼎仍居冠軍
items.title_en: Observation: The Three Major Taiwanese PCB Makers All Exceeded NT$10 Billion in Automotive Board Sales in the First Three Quarters of 2026, with Kenda Still Leading
paras: 健鼎(3044-TW)自2012年大舉切入汽車板市場以來，健鼎在2023年憑藉高產能的HDI製程擊敗敬鵬(2355-TW)，首度登上台廠汽車板出貨王寶座。同時，依最新財報顯示，2026年前三季包括健鼎、定穎(3715-TW)及敬鵬三大台系汽車板廠出貨金額都突破100億元，合計達342.07億元，其中並以健鼎120.72億元居冠，年增13.43%。
同時，汽車板市場需求已經趨於穩定，但在PCB上游CCL嚴重缺貨的壓抑之下，並已出現向小廠退出的現象，也將使這一區塊的市場更走上強者恒強強的走勢。
就2026年1-9月汽車板市場銷售冠軍的健鼎(3044-TW)來看，雖然網通與伺服器、記憶體模組板仍因AI需求提升而分別居銷售金額前二名，且 網通與伺服器已連續兩個季度占營收比重逾40%，且因營收的的快速成長，使汽車板的營收比重一路逐季下滑。
在2026年第三季健鼎營收306.94億元，通與伺服器板占比達41.2%，記憶體模組板占27.9%，汽車板占比下滑到15.2%，但累計健鼎2026年1-9月汽車板營收以120.72億元居三大汽車板廠之冠，且年增13.43%。
而第二名的定穎在汽車板的比重，在2026年以來則由54%、55%及57%一路攀升，定穎在2026年第三季營收87.05億元創新高，汽車板營收季增33%，營收占比並挺升到57%，也使定穎在2026年第三季單一汽車類別營收達49.52億元，也比健鼎的單46.65億元高。
定穎在2026年1-9月汽車板的營收117.8億元，較2025年同期的85.74億元，則出現37.39%的高幅成長。
而第三名的敬鵬在2026年1-3季營收131.08億元，但敬鵬對產品結構重新分類，對AI基建及航天類別產品獨立爲一類，營收占比爲9%，在汽車電子占比爲62%，同時，在先進駕駛輔助系統（ADAS）及智慧駕艙應用板占比爲19%，合計在汽車應用上占比79%，已經優於2025年2025年全年平均占比的77%。
敬鵬在2026年1-9月汽車板營收達103.55億元，也較2025年同期的85.74億元成長17.1%。
敬鵬2026年1-9月營收131.09億元，毛利率15.21%，年增4.54個百分點，2026年1-3季稅後純益達9.6億元，年增1.52倍，並且超越2025年全年獲利，每股純益達2.42元。
法人看好，敬鵬2026年整體營運可望較去年回升，隨著泰國新廠產能陸續加入，加上公司多年深耕泰國PCB市場、累積成熟的生產經驗，敬鵬在2027年成長動能也備受關注。法人預期，隨著汽車板需求穩健，加上泰國新產能挹注，敬鵬2026年營運可望優於去年，2027年成長表現更值得期待。
由於汽車板市場需求回穩有利敬鵬營收、敬鵬並跨足工業控制電子板逐漸有成，工業電子控制板在今年取得新訂單，業績預估將由今年下半年起走高，同時，敬鵬除在泰國生產基地原廠完成改造投產之外，新建生產大樓的新投資進展順利，預計2027年還有新產能投產，且目前對 CCL成本節節上攀的營運干擾，並已陸續向客戶端反映。
paras_en: Kenda (3044‑TW) entered the automotive board market on a large scale in 2012 and, thanks to its high‑capacity HDI process, beat Jingpeng (2355‑TW) in 2023 to become Taiwan’s top automotive board shipper for the first time. According to the latest financial report, the three major Taiwanese automotive‑board manufacturers—Kenda, Dingying (3715‑TW) and Jingpeng—each shipped over NT$10 billion in the first three quarters of 2026, totalling NT$342.07 billion, with Kenda leading at NT$120.72 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 13.43%.

At the same time, demand for automotive boards has stabilised, but severe shortages of CCL upstream in the PCB supply chain are forcing smaller players to exit, further concentrating the market among the strongest firms.

Looking at Kenda (3044‑TW), the 2026 Q1‑Q3 automotive‑board market champion, its network‑communication, server and memory‑module boards remain the top two revenue sources thanks to rising AI demand. Network‑communication and server boards have accounted for more than 40% of revenue for two consecutive quarters, and the rapid growth of those segments has caused the share of automotive‑board revenue to decline quarter by quarter.

In Q3 2026 Kenda posted revenue of NT$306.94 billion, with network‑communication and server boards making up 41.2%, memory‑module boards 27.9%, and automotive boards falling to 15.2%. Nevertheless, its cumulative automotive‑board revenue of NT$120.72 billion for the year‑to‑date remains the highest among the three manufacturers, up 13.43% year‑over‑year.

The second‑place maker Dingying saw its automotive‑board share rise steadily to 54%, 55% and 57% in 2026. Dingying achieved a record Q3 2026 revenue of NT$87.05 billion, with automotive‑board revenue jumping 33% quarter‑over‑quarter and its share climbing to 57%. This gave Dingying automotive‑board revenue of NT$49.52 billion in Q3, surpassing Kenda’s NT$46.65 billion.
Dingying’s automotive‑board revenue for the first three quarters of 2026 was NT$117.8 billion, compared with NT$85.74 billion in the same period of 2025, a strong 37.39% increase.

The third‑place player Jingpeng recorded NT$131.08 billion in revenue for Q1‑Q3 2026. Jingpeng re‑classified its product mix, separating AI‑infrastructure and aerospace products into a distinct category (9% of revenue). Automotive electronics now account for 62% of revenue, with ADAS and smart‑cabin application boards contributing 19%, bringing the total automotive‑related share to 79%, up from an average of 77% for the full year of 2025.
Jingpeng’s automotive‑board revenue reached NT$103.55 billion in the first three quarters of 2026, up 17.1% from NT$85.74 billion in the same period of 2025.

Jingpeng posted NT$131.09 billion in revenue for Q1‑Q3 2026, with a gross margin of 15.21%, up 4.54 percentage points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax for Q1‑Q3 was NT$9.6 billion, a 1.52‑fold increase over the prior year, surpassing full‑year 2025 earnings, and earnings per share reached NT$2.42.

Institutional investors are optimistic that Jingpeng’s overall 2026 operations will improve over the previous year. With the new Thai plant’s capacity coming online and the company’s long‑standing presence and mature production experience in Thailand’s PCB market, Jingpeng’s growth momentum in 2027 is also drawing attention. Analysts expect that steady automotive‑board demand, bolstered by the new Thai capacity, will make Jingpeng’s 2026 performance better than 2025, with even more promising growth in 2027.

Because automotive‑board demand has stabilised, it benefits Jingpeng’s revenue, and the company’s expansion into industrial‑control electronic boards is gaining traction. New industrial‑control board orders are expected to lift performance from the second half of this year onward. In addition to completing the refurbishment and start‑up of its original Thai production base, Jingpeng’s new manufacturing building is progressing smoothly, with another new capacity slated to come online in 2027. The firm is also actively addressing the rising CCL cost pressures that have been affecting operations, communicating these issues to its customers.

items.title: 台股震盪、企業獲利卻創高！AI三雄營收破紀錄 00961掌握科技金融雙引擎
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks Fluctuate, Yet Corporate Profits Hit New Highs! AI Trio Posts Record Revenues, 00961 Leverages Dual Tech and Finance Engines
paras: 台股近期上演急跌急漲行情，市場情緒隨國際政經消息劇烈擺盪，但企業基本面卻傳出截然不同的訊號。台灣10月出口衝上967.6億美元，年增58.9%，創單月歷史新高；台積電 (2330-TW) 10月營收達5,868.9億元，年增59.7%，同步刷新紀錄。隨著上市櫃公司10月營收陸續揭曉，AI伺服器供應鏈出貨暢旺、金融業獲利穩健，為台股中長線行情增添基本面支撐。
富蘭克林華美投信（00961-TW）FT臺灣永續高息經理人江明鴻指出，股市短線難免受到外資籌碼、利率政策與國際事件干擾，但真正決定企業長期價值的，仍是訂單能否轉化為營收、營收能否進一步創造獲利。從最新公布的經濟數據與企業財報觀察，台灣科技產業需求並未因股價震盪而明顯降溫，中長期仍可審慎樂觀看待。
其中，AI伺服器供應鏈表現尤其突出。華碩10月營收達1,076.2億元，年增62.3%，創歷史新高；廣達與緯創同月營收年增率更分別達約104%及117.6%，雙雙繳出翻倍成長成績單。隨著全球雲端服務商持續擴建AI基礎設施，相關訂單逐步轉化為實際出貨，顯示AI投資熱潮正從資本支出承諾，進一步反映在台灣供應鏈營收。
除了科技股成長動能強勁，金融族群也展現獲利韌性。上海商銀前10月累計稅後純益約164.15億元，年增約22%，每股盈餘達3.35元，前十個月獲利已超越去年全年。相較科技股受惠AI設備需求，金融股則可從核心業務與獲利累積提供不同收益來源，成為市場震盪期間值得關注的配置方向。
江明鴻表示，對於希望兼顧資本成長與現金流的投資人而言，高股息ETF不能只比較配息率，更應檢視成分股的獲利能力、產業分布與股利延續性。尤其當市場波動加劇，企業是否具備穩定創造現金流與持續成長的能力，將影響長期投資成果。以00961為例，透過科技成長與金融獲利兩大主軸，參與AI產業擴張及金融業經營成果，降低投資組合對單一產業的依賴。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market has recently seen rapid drops and rallies, with market sentiment swinging sharply on international political and economic news, while corporate fundamentals are sending a completely different signal. Taiwan’s October exports surged to $96.76 billion, up 58.9% year‑on‑year, setting a new monthly record; TSMC (2330‑TW) posted October revenue of NT$586.89 billion, up 59.7% year‑on‑year, also a record. As listed companies release their October revenues, strong shipments in the AI server supply chain and solid earnings in the financial sector are adding fundamental support to Taiwan’s medium‑ to long‑term market outlook.

Franklin Templeton (00961‑TW) manager Jiang Ming‑hong of FT Taiwan Sustainable High‑Yield noted that short‑term market moves are inevitably affected by foreign‑capital flows, interest‑rate policy and global events, but the true driver of a company’s long‑term value remains whether orders can be turned into revenue and whether that revenue can generate profit. From the latest economic data and corporate earnings, demand for Taiwan’s tech industry has not cooled noticeably despite stock‑price volatility, allowing a cautiously optimistic medium‑ to long‑term view.

The AI server supply chain stood out in particular. ASUS reported October revenue of NT$107.62 billion, up 62.3% year‑on‑year, a historic high; Quanta and Wistron posted year‑on‑year revenue growth of roughly 104% and 117.6% respectively, both delivering double‑digit growth scores. As global cloud providers continue to expand AI infrastructure, related orders are gradually turning into actual shipments, showing that the AI investment boom is moving from capital‑expenditure commitments to tangible revenue for Taiwan’s supply chain.

Beyond the strong growth momentum in tech stocks, the financial sector also demonstrated earnings resilience. Shanghai Commercial Bank recorded a cumulative after‑tax profit of about NT$16.415 billion for the first ten months of the year, up roughly 22% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of NT$3.35, already surpassing its full‑year profit from the previous year. While tech stocks benefit from AI equipment demand, financial stocks draw from core business and profit accumulation, offering a different source of returns and becoming a noteworthy allocation theme during market turbulence.

Jiang emphasized that investors seeking both capital growth and cash flow should not judge high‑dividend ETFs solely by yield, but also examine the profitability of constituent stocks, sector allocation and dividend sustainability. Especially when market volatility intensifies, a company’s ability to generate stable cash flow and sustain growth will affect long‑term investment outcomes. Using 00961 as an example, its focus on both tech growth and financial earnings allows participation in AI industry expansion and financial sector performance, reducing portfolio reliance on any single industry.

Amid a rapid rise in automated attacks and privilege‑abuse threats, the global AI‑protection market is projected to explode with a compound annual growth rate of up to 64.8%, heralding a shift from passive defense to platform‑based integration and igniting a new cybersecurity blue ocean.
AI agents grant system operation rights, making machine identity and zero‑trust the core of defense.

The key to shifting cybersecurity architecture lies in AI’s evolution from a passive Q&A tool to an autonomous AI agent capable of executing tasks. When these agents can directly read confidential data, modify code, or even conduct financial transactions, a “prompt‑injection” attack from an external data source or the abuse of long‑held privileges can cause damage far beyond traditional vulnerabilities. Consequently, defense can no longer focus solely on human account controls; it must extend to machine‑identity management, privileged‑access controls, and the principle of least privilege, using behavior‑correlation analytics to shorten response times.
Protection architectures are moving toward platform integration, with four sub‑domains targeting risk points.

Facing complex, cross‑system AI attack risks, enterprises are shifting cybersecurity procurement from single‑point tools to comprehensive platform integration and layered defense. Securing AI has developed four core defense lines: AI application security covering pre‑deployment testing and runtime protection; AI usage controls to prevent employee misuse of third‑party tools and data leakage; a centralized AI governance platform ensuring regulatory compliance and explainability; and an AI Gateway that serves as a unified security checkpoint between applications and model services.

items.title: AI伺服器成PC大廠2027年成長動能 華碩拚高雙位數增長、技嘉擴產搶市
items.title_en: AI Servers to Drive PC Giants' Growth in 2027: Asus Targets Double‑Digit Growth, Gigabyte Expands Production to Capture Market
paras: 台灣個人電腦與板卡品牌大廠華碩(2357-TW)、技嘉(2376-TW)近期召開法說會，釋出最新AI伺服器營運展望與全球產能規劃。三大廠一致看好AI伺服器成為驅動2027年營運成長的核心動能，其中華碩預估2026年第四季伺服器營收季增150%，技嘉則指出AI伺服器訂單能見度已直達2027年底
在具體財務數據與營運展望方面，華碩財務長吳長榮表示，受惠於強勁訂單動能與部分2026年第三季遞延訂單出貨，預估第四季伺服器營收將迎來爆發性增長，單季季增達150%，年增更高達280%。
華碩共同執行長許先越與胡書賓皆強調，儘管第三季有部分資料中心客戶因部署時程延後導致出貨遞延至第四季認列，第三季伺服器營收仍年增100%，占整體品牌營收比重達30%，且全年伺服器營收有信心達成至少150%以上的成長目標。
展望2027年營運表現，華碩共同執行長胡書賓指出，2027年伺服器業務達成雙位數甚至高雙位數年成長相當有把握，內部更以挑戰三位數成長為企圖心。
技嘉集團共同總經理李宜泰同樣表示，目前客戶對AI伺服器訂單需求非常強勁且能見度持續提高，成長動能可望一路延續至2027年底，發言人劉文忠更預期隨經濟規模擴大與費用率優化，2027年營業利益的成長幅度將優於營收成長幅度。
因應客戶強勁需求，技嘉持續調整全球生產布局並擴大資本支出，劉文忠透露2026年資本支出預計約為28至30億元新台幣，2027年資本支出規劃則預估提高至40億元新台幣。
在全球產能配置上，技嘉台灣廠將持續強化產能擴充並支援高階產品製造、工程及系統整合需求，美國廠作為提升北美市場在地供應彈性、加速客戶認證及發揮交付效率的核心，馬來西亞及其他東南亞基地則依客戶需求與供應鏈策略逐步擴充產能。
在伺服器產品線擴展方面，企業客戶為支援AI工作負載而擴建地端資料中心，同步為華碩通用型CPU伺服器帶來顯著帶動效應。胡書賓透露，華碩2026年第三季通用型CPU伺服器營收年增80%，占內部伺服器營收比重已達20%，未來除GPU伺服器外，通用型CPU伺服器也將是積極布局的重點。
至於技嘉2027年新專案來源，劉文忠分析成長動能主要來自整體市場需求擴張、新客戶數量增加，以及針對既有客戶提供涵蓋硬體、軟體與液冷機櫃等更多元的產品方案。
針對外部環境與產業趨勢變化，胡書賓分析近期市場出現資本市場融資條件趨緊與美國期中大選後地方政府對資料中心監管趨嚴兩大變化，可能導致體質不佳的Tier 2與Tier 3雲端服務商或NeoCloud面臨整併與淘汰，促使未來產業更集中於財務穩定、能掌握能源且兼顧環境與社區發展的核心玩家手中，而華碩2026年第四季及2027年已核准的建設案與訂單需求並未遇到延遲。
李宜泰則強調，技嘉在Neocloud客戶盡職調查與風險控制上維持穩健營運品質，並透過維持客戶組合與系統策略彈性控管風險，同時面對未來NVIDIA新管理團隊上任，雙方從管理層到執行面、產品與行銷皆有由上而下的深入合作，整體配合策略不會改變。
paras_en: Taiwan's major PC and motherboard brands Asus (2357‑TW) and Gigabyte (2376‑TW) recently held earnings calls, unveiling their latest AI server operating outlooks and global capacity plans. All three leading companies see AI servers as the core driver of growth through 2027, with Asus forecasting a 150% quarter‑over‑quarter increase in server revenue for Q4 2026 and Gigabyte noting that AI server order visibility extends to the end of 2027.

Regarding specific financial figures and outlook, Asus CFO Wu Chang‑Jung said that strong order momentum and the shipment of some deferred Q3 2026 orders will trigger explosive growth in Q4 server revenue, with a 150% sequential increase and an annual rise of up to 280%.

Asus co‑CEOs Hsu Hsien‑Yue and Hu Shu‑Pin emphasized that, although some data‑center customers delayed deployments and shifted shipments to Q4, Q3 server revenue still grew 100% year‑over‑year, accounting for 30% of total brand revenue, and the company is confident that full‑year server revenue will achieve at least 150% growth.

Looking ahead to 2027 performance, Asus co‑CEO Hu Shu‑Pin said the company is confident of achieving double‑digit, even high double‑digit, annual growth in the server business, and internally is aiming for triple‑digit growth as an ambition.

Gigabyte Group co‑General Manager Li Yi‑Tai also stated that customer demand for AI server orders is very strong and visibility continues to improve, with growth momentum expected to carry through to the end of 2027. Spokesperson Liu Wen‑Chung further projected that, as the economy scales and cost efficiencies improve, 2027 operating profit growth will outpace revenue growth.

In response to strong customer demand, Gigabyte is continuously adjusting its global production layout and expanding capital expenditures. Liu Wen‑Chung disclosed that capital spending for 2026 is expected to be around NT$2.8‑3.0 billion, with a planned increase to NT$4.0 billion in 2027.

Regarding global capacity allocation, Gigabyte’s Taiwan plant will keep strengthening capacity expansion to support high‑end product manufacturing, engineering and system‑integration needs. The U.S. plant serves as the core for enhancing local supply flexibility in North America, accelerating customer certification and delivery efficiency, while the Malaysia and other Southeast Asian sites will gradually expand capacity according to customer demand and supply‑chain strategy.

On the server product line expansion, enterprise customers are building edge data centers to support AI workloads, which in turn significantly boosts Asus’s general‑purpose CPU servers. Hu Shu‑Pin revealed that Asus’s Q3 2026 general‑purpose CPU server revenue grew 80% year‑over‑year, now representing 20% of internal server revenue, and that beyond GPU servers, general‑purpose CPU servers will remain a key focus for future deployment.

As for Gigabyte’s new project sources in 2027, Liu Wen‑Chung analyzed that growth will mainly stem from overall market demand expansion, an increase in new customers, and offering existing customers more diversified solutions covering hardware, software and liquid‑cooling racks.

Addressing external environment and industry trend changes, Hu Shu‑Pin noted two recent shifts: tighter capital‑market financing conditions and stricter post‑midterm‑election data‑center regulations by U.S. local governments. These could force weaker Tier 2 and Tier 3 cloud providers or NeoClouds into consolidation or exit, concentrating the industry around financially stable players with energy control and environmental and community development focus. Asus’s approved construction projects and order demand for Q4 2026 and 2027 have not faced delays.

Li Yi‑Tai emphasized that Gigabyte maintains robust operational quality in NeoCloud customer due diligence and risk control, managing portfolio and system‑strategy flexibility to mitigate risk. He also noted that with NVIDIA’s new management team taking over, both parties will deepen cooperation from leadership to execution, product and marketing, and the overall partnership strategy will remain unchanged.

items.title: 00981A定期定額扣款衝破百億超車00919 展現存股吸金新戰力
items.title_en: 00981A Regular‑Investment Deductions Break 10 Billion, Overtaking 00919, Showcasing New Capital‑Attraction Power for Holding‑Stock Strategies
paras: 主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)受益人再登百萬，就連定期定額人氣也節節攀升，據CMoney統計至今年10月底，00981A今年定期定額人氣大增超過11.22萬人，推升今年以來累積扣款金額已突破百億元大關，是扣款金額唯一達百億元的主動式ETF，展現強勁吸金實力。
觀察今年台股ETF定期定額新增人氣榜單，市值型龍頭元大台灣50(0050-TW)以60.07萬人穩坐冠軍，00981A今年以來新增扣款人數達11.22萬人，僅次於0050，奪下亞軍寶座，並領先群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)所增加的7.78萬人。
若從今年累計扣款金額來看，0050以1,109.56億元居冠，00981A則以119.02億元奪下亞軍，超車00919的99.33億元。
ETF達人分析，第一、二名扣款人數和扣款金額雖然差距很大，但0050是2003年掛牌，累積了長達23年的龐大存股族基本盤；反觀00981A，於2025年5月底才正式掛牌上市，是今年才邁入第二年的「新生代」ETF，能以一年多的時間就吸金破百億，甚至超車上市多年的人氣高股息ETF 00919，顯示00981A成長爆發力相當驚人，也意味著00981A已成為中長線定期定額布局台股的新戰力。
展望台股後市，統一投信台股研究團隊表示，台股短線融資大幅縮減，也意味著槓桿籌碼逐步清理，搭配國安基金及禁空令等政策支撐，且AI產業基本面仍正向，在各國持續進行AI軍備競賽下，整體產業仍處於「需求遠大於供給」的格局，AI長線多頭趨勢並未改變，投資人可透過定期定額搭上AI長線列車。

paras_en: Active Uni‑Taiwan Stock Growth ETF (00981A‑TW) saw its beneficiary count exceed one million, and its regular‑investment popularity kept climbing. According to CMoney, by the end of October this year, 00981A’s regular‑investment participants surged by more than 112,200, pushing the cumulative deduction amount past the NT$10 billion mark—the only active ETF to reach that level, demonstrating strong fund‑raising capability.

Looking at this year’s new‑investor rankings for Taiwan‑stock ETFs, market‑cap leader Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) stayed on top with 600,700 new participants. 00981A added 112,200 new investors, ranking second behind 0050 and ahead of Quanta Taiwan Select High‑Yield (00919‑TW), which gained 77,800 participants.
In terms of cumulative deduction amounts for the year, 0050 led with NT$110.956 billion, while 00981A took second place with NT$11.902 billion, surpassing 00919’s NT$9.933 billion.

ETF analysts note that although the gap in participant numbers and deduction amounts between the top two is large, 0050 has been listed since 2003 and has built a 23‑year‑long base of long‑term holders. By contrast, 00981A was only listed at the end of May 2025 and is in its second year; yet it has already attracted over NT$10 billion in a little more than a year, even outpacing the longer‑established high‑dividend ETF 00919. This highlights 00981A’s explosive growth and its emergence as a new mid‑to‑long‑term regular‑investment vehicle for Taiwan stocks.

Looking ahead, Uni‑Invest’s Taiwan‑stock research team says that short‑term margin financing has contracted sharply, indicating a gradual cleanup of leveraged positions. Combined with support from the National Security Fund and short‑selling bans, and a still‑positive AI industry fundamentals, the AI sector remains in a “demand far exceeds supply” environment amid a global AI arms race. The long‑term bullish trend for AI is unchanged, and investors can use regular‑investment plans to ride the AI long‑term train.

items.title: Megaspeed發佈聲明！證實黃樂去年8月離職  黃仁勳緋聞牽出國安疑慮
items.title_en: Megaspeed Issues Statement Confirming Alice Huang's August 2025 Resignation; Huang Renxun Romance Sparks National‑Security Concerns
paras: 新加坡雲端運算公司 Megaspeed 周日（15日）發布聲明，證實中國籍商界人士黃樂（Alice Huang）已於2025年8月30日正式離職，目前與公司沒有任何職務關係。黃樂與輝達(NVDA-US) 前執行長黃仁勳的關係，以及她遭美方懷疑涉及中國間諜活動的傳聞，引發美國國安疑慮。
根據《路透》報導，Megaspeed 是輝達在亞太地區的商業合作夥伴。此前有報導指稱，黃仁勳曾與這名前 Megaspeed 高階主管發生婚外情，而美國當局懷疑黃艾莉是中國間諜，使該公司受到外界關注。
Megaspeed 在聲明中表示，不對黃樂的個人及私人事務發表評論。公司也強調，近期媒體報導對其業務、供應鏈及全球營運提出的部分說法，缺乏可查證的證據支持。
《紐約時報》2025年10月報導指出，Megaspeed 正接受美國政府調查，調查重點在於該公司是否協助中國客戶取得受到華府出口管制的輝達晶片。不過，中國已否認相關指控，Megaspeed 迄今也未被認定違反相關規定。
針對相關調查及報導，Megaspeed 表示，公司從事的都是合法合規的商業活動，並已聘請外部法律顧問展開全面內部調查。
公司也指出，其營運及供應鏈管控機制均以遵守適用法律與法規為設計原則，包括美國出口管制規定。
根據華府研究機構 C4ADS 檢視企業登記資料後發布的資訊，黃樂於2023年3月成為 Megaspeed 控股股東。
《路透》就 Megaspeed 的聲明向美國政府及輝達尋求評論，但雙方均未立即回覆。
paras_en: Singapore cloud‑computing firm Megaspeed issued a statement on Sunday (the 15th) confirming that Chinese businessperson Alice Huang resigned on August 30, 2025, and currently holds no position with the company. Huang's relationship with Nvidia (NVDA-US) former CEO Jensen Huang, and rumors that she is suspected by U.S. authorities of involvement in Chinese espionage, have raised U.S. national‑security concerns.

According to Reuters, Megaspeed is Nvidia’s commercial partner in the Asia‑Pacific region. Earlier reports alleged that Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair with the former Megaspeed senior executive, and U.S. officials suspect Alice Huang of being a Chinese spy, drawing external scrutiny to the firm.

In its statement, Megaspeed said it would not comment on Huang’s personal or private matters. The company also emphasized that recent media reports containing certain claims about its business, supply chain, and global operations lack verifiable evidence.

A New York Times report from October 2025 noted that Megaspeed is under investigation by the U.S. government, focusing on whether the company helped Chinese customers obtain Nvidia chips subject to U.S. export controls. China has denied the allegations, and Megaspeed has not yet been found to have violated any regulations.

Regarding the investigation and media coverage, Megaspeed said that all its activities are lawful and compliant, and that it has hired external legal counsel to conduct a comprehensive internal review.
The company also pointed out that its operational and supply‑chain control mechanisms are designed to comply with all applicable laws and regulations, including U.S. export‑control rules.
Based on information released by the Washington‑based research organization C4ADS after reviewing corporate registration data, Alice Huang became a controlling shareholder of Megaspeed in March 2023.
Reuters sought comments from the U.S. government and Nvidia on Megaspeed’s statement, but neither party responded immediately.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：AI交易關鍵時刻！輝達首份無黃仁勳財報、Anthropic重磅IPO 「川習普」三方會議登場
items.title_en: This Week's Trading Notes: Pivotal Moment for AI Trading! Nvidia’s First Earnings Without Jensen Huang, Anthropic’s Major IPO, and the “Trump‑Xi‑Putin” Trilateral Meeting
paras: 本週國際大事包括輝達第3季財報，這家人工智慧(AI)晶片巨頭將在黃仁勳閃辭執行長及股價重挫之際舉行財報電話會議，而市場高度期待的AI新創Anthropic終於要掛牌上市，這兩個重大事件將考驗AI交易能否續航。此外，美國總統川普週四將與中國國家主席習近平、俄羅斯總統普丁舉行三方會談，這將是川習兩人今年第三度面對面會晤。

1、輝達首份無黃仁勳財報

黃仁勳卸職執行長後的輝達(NVDA-US)首場財報電話會議預定週二(17日)盤後登場，將由先前擔任財務長的臨時執行長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)主持。
分析師預期，第3季營收估年增約90%至1090億美元，EPS估2.46美元。儘管市場認為這份財報仍將交出亮眼成績，但投資人更關注黃仁勳離職後的領導真空、成長預測是否有變化、AI融資承諾會否延續等問題。
分析師也好奇，輝達管理層是否會大舉實施庫藏股以支撐股價，該公司截至9月底還有2,350億美元的回購授權額度。
輝達股價上週累計下跌13%，連續第六週收黑，創2012年以來最長連跌紀錄，上週五收盤市值已跌破4兆美元。專家表示，考量到輝達目前籠罩在不確定性之中，如果財報表現不如預期，市場施加的任何懲罰都會被放大。
輝達有「AI中央銀行」之稱，大規模提供資金支持客戶擴建、資金又透過晶片採購流回輝達的「循環融資」模式，一直受到關注。華爾街日報(WSJ)報導，幾個月前，克瑞斯和黃仁勳對「循環融資」的安排有不同意見。這導致市場更加關注，輝達未來是否會繼續以大規模融資帶動晶片銷售。
專家表示，這場財報會議的考驗不只在單季數字，黃仁勳離任後，克瑞斯需要讓投資人相信，輝達仍能維持執行力、財務紀律與客戶關係，並在領導交接期間持續推進AI產品路線。

2、Anthropic上市

Anthropic(ANT-US)預定週三(18日)為首次公開發行(IPO)定價，每股估落在70-78美元，接著週四在那斯達克以代碼「ANT」掛牌交易。該公司及部分投資人計劃出售8.25億股股票，最多募資644億美元，估值最高可達1.4兆美元。
在Anthropic之前，馬斯克旗下SpaceX(SPCX-US)今年6月也曾風光IPO，當時以近1.75兆美元估值募到750億美元。但SpaceX上市後走勢顛簸，目前股價僅略高於135美元的IPO發行價，8月更曾跌到約105美元。
Madison Investments首席投資策略師Patrick Ryan表示，如果Anthropic上市後表現不佳，可能釋出另一個警訊，凸顯投資人對AI交易的壓力正在增加。
Peter Thiel家族辦公室管理合夥人Jack Selby也警告，若這樁備受期待的AI大型IPO定價遠低於市場原先預期，或掛牌後表現疲弱，可能加劇AI股修正。
值得注意的是，由於輝達已意在Anthropic IPO同步進行的私募配售中認購約100億美元股票，如今黃仁勳離任，投資人正密切觀察是否波及這項投資承諾。

3、川習普三方會議

白宮已確認，美國總統川普、中國國家主席習近平與俄羅斯總統普丁，將於週四(19日)在深圳舉行的亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)場邊舉行三方會談。這將是川習今年第三度面對面會晤。
川普計劃與習近平、普丁討論伊朗戰事，但將避開烏克蘭議題。一名白宮官員說，三方會談旨在開啟核裁軍對話，是「希望往後能有成果的對話的開端」，但不預期會宣布任何協議。分析師指出，外界對會談成果的預期偏低，象徵意義大於實質。
另外，隨著民主黨在美國期中選舉勝出，可能強化中國在貿易談判中的籌碼，也可能促使民主黨向川普施壓，要求解凍對台軍售案。
至於輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳的婚外情風波是否影響美中晶片議題，白宮官員表示，輝達的情況不應對這趟訪問造成任何影響，美國不會把出口管制的執行拿來與外國談判，川普也不打算就此事質問習近平。
白宮官員也透露，特斯拉(TSLA-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克將隨同川普前往中國深圳，出席APEC峰會。

4、Fed會議紀錄、華許主持AI小組會議

聯準會(Fed)週三將公布10月會議紀錄，Fed在該次會議上按兵不動，但近來多名Fed官員都有擔憂通膨升溫的鷹派發言，加上10月消費者物價指數(CPI)顯示通膨加速升溫，市場更加肯定12月升息的可能性，甚至開始關注明年1月是否可能連續升息。
如果Fed真的在12月和1月接連升息，將是2023年以來首次連續升息。投資人原本只預期12月與明年3月升息，但上週起已反映對12月、明年1月及3月各升息1碼的預期。
本週仍有多名Fed官員將發表演說，至於Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)，自10月決策會後記者會後便未再公開發言。他預定週一為他成立的AI與生產力工作小組主持會議，外界普遍不預期他會偏離多次表明的立場，也就是不對近期貨幣政策走向提供任何前瞻指引。

5、油價走勢

中東外交局勢預期轉變，加上美國需求降溫，正在促使國際油價下跌，但過程並不平順。
油價上週出現雙位數跌幅，已跌到每桶約90美元的兩個月低點，在北半球許多地區準備迎接寒冬之際，油價下跌可能有助於減輕政策制定者與家庭面臨的通膨壓力。
然而，近期由伊朗支持的葉門青年運動(Houthis)攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯基礎設施、運載原油駛離波灣的油輪頻繁遇襲，以及俄羅斯持續受到供應干擾，都讓市場意識到，任何新的供應中斷都可能迅速重新推升油價壓力。
paras_en: This week’s international headlines include Nvidia’s Q3 earnings, with the AI chip giant holding its earnings call as former CEO Jensen Huang steps down and the stock plummets, and the highly anticipated AI startup Anthropic finally going public. These two events will test whether AI‑driven trading can sustain its momentum. In addition, U.S. President Donald Trump will hold a trilateral meeting on Thursday with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, marking the third face‑to‑face encounter between Trump and Xi this year.
This week’s trading notes (20261116–1120)

1. Nvidia’s First Earnings Without Jensen Huang
After Jensen Huang’s resignation, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) will hold its first earnings call on Tuesday (the 17th) after market close, chaired by interim CEO and former CFO Colette Kress.

Analysts expect Q3 revenue to grow about 90% year‑over‑year to $109 billion, with EPS around $2.46. While the market believes the results will still be impressive, investors are focused on the leadership vacuum after Huang’s departure, any changes to growth forecasts, and whether AI financing commitments will continue.

Analysts are also curious whether Nvidia’s management will launch a large share‑repurchase program to support the stock; the company still has a $235 billion buyback authorization as of the end of September.

Nvidia’s share price fell 13% last week, marking a sixth consecutive week of losses—the longest streak since 2012—and its market cap slipped below $4 trillion on Friday’s close. Experts warn that, given the current uncertainty surrounding Nvidia, any earnings miss could amplify market penalties.

Nvidia is often called the “AI central bank,” providing massive financing to customers for expansion, with funds flowing back to Nvidia through chip purchases in a “circular financing” model that has drawn attention. The Wall Street Journal reported that months ago Kress and Huang disagreed over the structure of this circular financing, raising questions about whether Nvidia will continue to drive chip sales with large‑scale financing in the future.

Experts say the earnings call will test more than just quarterly numbers; after Huang’s exit, Kress must convince investors that Nvidia can maintain execution, financial discipline, and customer relationships while advancing its AI product roadmap during the leadership transition.

2. Anthropic IPO
Anthropic (ANT‑US) is slated to set its IPO price on Wednesday (the 18th) at $70‑$78 per share, then begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker “ANT” on Thursday. The company and certain investors plan to sell 825 million shares, raising up to $64.4 billion and valuing the firm at as much as $1.4 trillion.

Before Anthropic, Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX‑US) went public in June with a near‑$1.75 trillion valuation, raising $75 billion. After listing, SpaceX’s stock has been volatile, currently trading only slightly above its $135 IPO price and dipping to about $105 in August.

Madison Investments chief investment strategist Patrick Ryan warned that a weak post‑IPO performance by Anthropic could send another warning signal, highlighting growing pressure on investors in AI‑driven trading.

Jack Selby, managing partner of the Thiel family office, also cautioned that if this highly anticipated large AI IPO is priced far below market expectations or underperforms after debut, it could exacerbate a correction in AI stocks.

It is noteworthy that Nvidia intended to participate in a private placement alongside Anthropic’s IPO, committing roughly $10 billion; with Huang’s departure, investors are closely watching whether that commitment will be affected.

3. Trump‑Xi‑Putin Trilateral Meeting
The White House has confirmed that U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin will hold a three‑way meeting on Thursday (the 19th) on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen. This will be the third face‑to‑face encounter between Trump and Xi this year.

Trump plans to discuss the war in Iran with Xi and Putin but will avoid the Ukraine issue. A White House official said the talks aim to launch a nuclear‑arms‑reduction dialogue, describing it as “the start of a conversation we hope will yield results,” though no agreements are expected. Analysts note that expectations for concrete outcomes are low, with symbolic significance outweighing substance.
Additionally, with Democrats winning the U.S. midterms, China may gain leverage in trade talks, and Democrats could pressure Trump to unfreeze arms sales to Taiwan.

Regarding former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair scandal, a White House official said the matter should not affect the U.S.–China chip discussion; the U.S. will not tie export‑control enforcement to foreign negotiations, and Trump does not intend to question Xi about it.
White House officials also disclosed that Elon Musk, CEO of Tesla (TSLA‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US), will accompany Trump to Shenzhen for the APEC summit.

4. Fed Meeting Minutes and Kevin Warsh Chairs AI Working Group
The Federal Reserve will release the October meeting minutes on Wednesday. The Fed held rates steady at that meeting, but several officials have recently voiced hawkish concerns about rising inflation, and October CPI data showed accelerating price pressures, prompting the market to price in a higher likelihood of a December rate hike and even consider a possible January hike next year.

If the Fed does raise rates in both December and January, it would be the first consecutive hikes since 2023. Investors originally expected hikes in December and March 2025, but since last week have begun pricing in one‑point moves in December, January and March.

Several Fed officials will speak this week, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who has not spoken publicly since the post‑meeting press conference in October, is scheduled to chair a meeting of the AI‑and‑productivity working group on Monday. Market participants do not expect him to deviate from his previously stated stance of offering no forward guidance on monetary policy direction.

5. Oil Price Trends
Shifts in Middle‑East diplomatic dynamics, combined with cooling U.S. demand, are pushing international oil prices lower, though the decline is uneven.

Oil prices fell double‑digit percentages last week, reaching about $90 per barrel—a two‑month low—as many northern‑hemisphere regions brace for winter. The drop could help ease inflation pressures on policymakers and households.

However, recent attacks by Iran‑backed Houthi rebels on Saudi infrastructure, frequent assaults on oil tankers transporting crude from the Gulf, and ongoing supply disruptions affecting Russia have reminded markets that any new supply shock could quickly reignite upward pressure on oil prices.

items.title: 矽谷科技巨頭押注川普恐踢鐵板！OpenAI、Meta政治豪賭埋下AI產業隱憂
paras: 矽谷科技巨頭長期以擅長預測未來、掌握科技趨勢自居，但在美國政治局勢變化之際，OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）、SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克等科技領袖卻選擇公開支持美國總統川普的政策議程。隨著期中選舉結果改變政治版圖，這項押注不僅可能讓科技業面臨更大的政治風險，也讓外界開始質疑，這些自詡具有遠見的企業領袖，是否高估了自己的政治判斷力。
《MIT Technology Review》指出，科技業領袖在距離期中選舉僅剩5周時，仍聚集白宮與川普合影，並支持他的「超級智慧」（Super Intelligence）議程。
然而，當時已有數十項民調顯示，反川普情緒持續升高，且兩黨選民對人工智慧（AI）及資料中心的反對聲浪也逐漸擴大，科技巨頭卻為了爭取短期政治利益，將企業長期發展押在川普政府身上。
分析指出，這項決策如今可能帶來反效果。科技業不僅可能成為新政治局勢下的攻防目標，企業領導人的政治立場也可能成為難以擺脫的包袱。

科技業員工也不解 高層選舉後反應低調

科技業內部對高層的政治押注同樣感到困惑。曾與OpenAI、Meta(META-US) 等企業員工交流的評論者指出，選舉結果出爐後，部分科技公司高層至今沒有公開說明後續方向。
Meta執行長祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）尚未在公司內部談論選舉結果，另一家AI企業員工也表示，管理層在Slack上的發言相當有限。
員工普遍擔心，民主黨重新掌握華府政治主導權後，可能推動限制資料中心的立法，也關注企業高層將如何調整策略。不過，比起政策變化，更令部分員工不解的是，為何企業領導人沒有提前察覺政治風向可能轉變。
矽谷管理文化向來推崇冰球傳奇球星葛瑞茲基（Wayne Gretzky）的名言：「滑向冰球即將到達的位置，而不是它現在所在的位置。」這套思維強調預測趨勢、提前布局，而非被動回應眼前局勢。
科技新創也經常透過轉型調整商業模式，無法跟上時代的企業往往遭到市場淘汰。然而，評論指出，祖克柏、OpenAI共同創辦人布羅克曼（Greg Brockman），以及其他AI產業領袖和創投業者，這次卻選擇將自身與川普的政治、文化及商業議程緊密綁定，陷入可能難以脫身的政治困境。

科技巨頭放棄跨黨派布局 長期投資恐成政治攻防目標

評論表示，這場風波反映出科技業領袖並非如外界想像般無所不知。即使在社群媒體或AI領域具有深厚專業，也不代表他們同樣擅長判斷政治、經濟或其他領域的發展。
白宮接觸機會、政府補貼，以及參與自身產業監管的機會，可能讓科技業高層過度重視眼前利益，忽略美國政治權力更迭的基本規律。
相較之下，摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 、波音(BA-US) 等大型企業，通常不會將自身公開綁定特定政治陣營。這是企業長期經營累積的經驗：美國政府每4年可能更替，但企業合約及大型投資計畫往往長達10年，商業布局必須超越單一政府任期。
因此，多數企業會盡可能維持與兩黨的關係，避免政策變動直接衝擊商業模式。然而，科技巨頭這次選擇押注川普，卻可能讓旗下最重要的發展計畫，尤其是涉及電網接入及資料中心許可的大型投資，成為民主黨的優先監督與政治攻防對象。
此外，企業政治形象一旦受損，也不像軟體功能或程式碼能夠隨時修改。評論以Palantir(PLTR-US) 執行長卡普（Alex Karp）為例，指出他過去一年不斷發表強硬言論，並向投資人強調公司「完全反覺醒」，未來是否還能突然轉向進步派立場，恐怕難以取信於外界。
一名曾與祖克柏密切共事的Meta員工也形容，祖克柏雖然擅長長期思考，卻未必有明確的實現路徑，決策方式更像是廣泛嘗試、寄望成功，再觀察後續發展。該員工並指出，Facebook過去也很少針對重大策略失誤進行完整檢討。

AI競賽政治化 損害產業爭取基礎建設的籌碼

評論認為，科技業這次最大的失誤，是將AI產業發展捲入美國文化及政治戰線。過去光纖技術與無線通訊基礎建設等重大科技發展，並未成為明顯的黨派政治議題，但矽谷對川普政府的靠攏，卻讓AI逐漸成為文化戰爭的一部分。
如今，從加州到佛羅里達州，民眾在表決資料中心建設提案時，考量的已不只是技術或經濟效益，還包括企業與政治陣營的關係。
分析指出，對急於在AI競賽中取得領先地位的科技巨頭而言，這種政治風險尤其值得警惕。企業領袖過度聚焦AI競爭的迫切性，卻低估公眾信任與企業聲譽受損後，可能對產業發展造成的衝擊。
資料中心、電力供應及相關基礎建設，都是AI產業持續擴張的重要條件，而這些投資同樣需要地方政府與民眾支持。當科技企業失去原本的社會信任，即使掌握領先技術，也可能難以取得推動產業發展所需的資源與許可。
這場政治押注已經動搖矽谷長期以來的一項核心形象：科技領袖總能比其他人更早看見未來。

items.title: OpenAI測試ChatGPT商家功能！導入AI導購代理  商家可上架商品、掌握推薦流量
items.title_en: OpenAI Tests ChatGPT Merchant Feature! Introducing AI Shopping Agent; Merchants Can List Products and Track Recommendation Traffic
paras: 生成式人工智慧（AI）競爭延伸至電商領域。OpenAI近日宣布，開始測試ChatGPT商家功能，讓通過驗證的美國商家認領品牌頁面、提交商品價格與庫存目錄，並導入商家AI代理，直接在ChatGPT內回答消費者的商品問題，將AI對話轉化為購物入口。
這項測試也提供品牌導購與商家代理功能。商家可在後台更新商品資訊，讓AI代理掌握產品內容，依據消費者需求提供回答；消費者則能從ChatGPT的商品推薦進入商家頁面，與品牌專屬AI代理展開獨立對話，進一步詢問產品功效。
當消費者決定購買時，AI會提供商家官方網站連結，引導消費者完成交易。
商家也能透過後台查看過去28天內被ChatGPT提及的次數及商品點擊量等數據，掌握品牌在AI對話中的曝光情況。
這並非ChatGPT首次涉足電商交易。去年9月，美國用戶已可透過ChatGPT對話直接購買Etsy(ETSY-US) 商品；此次推出的商家測試，則進一步讓品牌能管理自己的商品資訊，並透過AI代理與潛在買家互動。
AI逐漸成為消費者搜尋商品與評估購買選項的管道。Adobe(ADBE-US) 今年9月針對美國零售網站的數據顯示，來自AI工具的網站點擊量年增71%；而在已進入零售網站的訪客中，AI來源流量的購買轉換率比非AI來源高出90%。
大型零售與科技業者也陸續布局AI購物服務。美妝零售商 Sephora 今年3月已在ChatGPT推出品牌應用程式，讓消費者透過對話取得符合自身膚質的化妝品推薦；若連結會員帳號，系統還能參考個人偏好提供商品建議。
沃爾瑪(WMT-US) 則更早將購物服務整合至ChatGPT，讓消費者能直接在對話中選購商品，並使用沃爾瑪會員權益與支付方式。
沃爾瑪曾指出，零售服務正從被動回應轉向主動提供協助，業者需要運用AI掌握消費者需求，在顧客提出問題前就提供適當推薦。
除了ChatGPT，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 與Google(GOOGL-US) 也在擴大AI購物功能。亞馬遜近期邀請部分美國用戶測試Alexa簡訊購物服務，未來幾周計畫向數百萬用戶開放。消費者可傳送食譜照片，讓Alexa辨識所需食材並加入購物車，也能依照指示直接下單。
Google則已開始在加拿大推出直接結帳功能。消費者透過搜尋引擎的AI模式或Gemini比較商品時，符合條件的商品可直接進行結帳。
隨著消費者逐漸習慣在購物前先向AI詢問商品資訊，AI平台也開始從資訊搜尋延伸至商品推薦與交易環節。對商家而言，ChatGPT等工具不只是新的導購服務，也可能成為接觸潛在客戶的流量入口。
當消費者透過AI比較商品時，能否進入最初的推薦清單，可能影響後續取得訂單的機會。隨著電商與AI服務持續整合，商家如何管理商品資料、提高在AI推薦中的能見度，也將成為新的競爭課題。
paras_en: Generative AI competition is extending into e‑commerce. OpenAI announced it is now testing a ChatGPT merchant feature that lets verified U.S. merchants claim brand pages, submit product price and inventory catalogs, and deploy a merchant AI agent to answer consumer product questions directly within ChatGPT, turning AI dialogue into a shopping gateway.

The test also provides brand‑shopping and merchant‑agent capabilities.
