Merchants can update product information in a backend so the AI agent knows the product details and can answer based on consumer needs; consumers can follow product recommendations from ChatGPT to a merchant page and start a separate conversation with the brand‑specific AI agent to ask about product benefits.
When a consumer decides to buy, the AI supplies a link to the merchant’s official website, guiding the consumer to complete the transaction.
Merchants can also view data in the backend showing how many times their brand was mentioned by ChatGPT and product click‑throughs over the past 28 days, giving insight into AI‑driven exposure.

This is not ChatGPT’s first foray into e‑commerce. In September last year, U.S. users could already purchase Etsy (ETSY‑US) items through a ChatGPT conversation; the new merchant test further lets brands manage their own product information and interact with potential buyers via an AI agent.

AI is increasingly becoming a channel for consumers to search for products and evaluate purchase options. Adobe (ADBE‑US) reported in September that AI‑driven website clicks for U.S. retail sites grew 71% year‑over‑year, and among visitors who reached retail sites, the purchase conversion rate from AI traffic was 90% higher than non‑AI traffic.

Large retailers and tech firms are also rolling out AI shopping services. Beauty retailer Sephora launched a brand app on ChatGPT in March, allowing consumers to get makeup recommendations suited to their skin type through conversation; linking a loyalty account lets the system also factor personal preferences into product suggestions.
Walmart (WMT‑US) integrated shopping services into ChatGPT even earlier, enabling consumers to select and purchase items directly in the chat and use Walmart membership benefits and payment methods.

Walmart has said retail services are shifting from passive response to proactive assistance, and operators need to use AI to anticipate consumer needs and provide appropriate recommendations before a question is asked.

Beyond ChatGPT, Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Google (GOOGL‑US) are expanding AI shopping features. Amazon recently invited a subset of U.S. users to test an Alexa text‑shopping service and plans to roll it out to millions in the coming weeks; users can send a recipe photo, have Alexa identify needed ingredients, add them to a cart, and place orders by voice.
Google has begun rolling out a direct checkout feature in Canada. When consumers compare products via the search engine’s AI mode or Gemini, qualifying items can be checked out directly.

As consumers grow accustomed to asking AI for product information before buying, AI platforms are moving from information search to recommendation and transaction stages. For merchants, tools like ChatGPT are not just new referral services but could become traffic entry points to reach potential customers.

When consumers compare products through AI, whether a brand appears in the initial recommendation list can affect its chances of securing orders. As e‑commerce and AI services continue to merge, how merchants manage product data and boost visibility in AI recommendations will become a fresh competitive challenge.

items.title: 誰能駕馭這頭巨獸？哈佛教授：黃仁勳辭職後  輝達面臨「20年最難接班」問題
items.title_en: Who Can Tame This Beast? Harvard Professor Says Nvidia Faces Its Most Difficult Succession in 20 Years After Jensen Huang’s Resignation
paras: 輝達創辦人黃仁勳上周突宣布辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效，結束其長達33年的掌舵生涯。這位長期自詡「無可替代」的創辦人離去，令這家全球最具價值的AI晶片巨頭瞬間陷入接班真空。
黃仁勳歷來採取高度集權的扁平化管理，擁有約60名直屬部屬，決策權高度集中於一身；英偉達董事會過去甚至未設董事長職位，無人能制衡其決定。
黃仁勳親自建立並維繫公司最重要的外部人脈，從拉攏美國總統川普，到與台積電創辦人張忠謀維持密切關係，為輝達取得稀缺產能優先權。
憑藉個人直覺，黃仁勳帶領公司在AI等領域做出大膽早期押注，將輝達打造成全球最具價值企業之一。
據悉，黃仁勳雖保持低調，但仍參與繼任過程，並已與至少一名潛在候選人通話。
然而，尋找繼任者難度極高。哈佛商學院教授Andy Wu直言，這是「至少10到20年來最難填補的執行長職位」。他指出，AI投資本質上要求承擔風險，這類看似非理性的押注，需要一位具備創辦人同等掌控力與感召力的領導者，才能在投資者面前保持靈活溝通，並激勵員工執行外界眼中「近乎荒謬」的遠景。
目前，輝達財務長柯蕾絲(Colette Kress)已出任臨時執行長，董事會同步啟動正式執行長遴選，內外部人選均納入考量。這家與黃仁勳個人願景、魅力深度交織的企業，正式邁入未知的「後黃仁勳時代」。
paras_en: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang abruptly announced last week that he is stepping down from his roles as president, chief executive officer and director, effective immediately, ending a 33‑year reign. The long‑time self‑described “irreplaceable” founder’s departure leaves the world’s most valuable AI‑chip giant suddenly facing a leadership vacuum.

Huang has always run a highly centralized, flat organization, with about 60 direct reports and decision‑making power concentrated in his hands; Nvidia’s board historically did not even have a chairman, leaving no one to check his decisions.

Huang personally built and maintained the company’s most important external relationships, from courting former U.S. President Donald Trump to keeping close ties with TSMC founder Morris Chang, securing priority access to scarce manufacturing capacity for Nvidia.
Relying on his own intuition, Huang led the company to make bold early bets in AI and other fields, turning Nvidia into one of the world’s most valuable enterprises.
Sources say that although Huang is keeping a low profile, he is still involved in the succession process and has already spoken with at least one potential candidate.

Finding a successor, however, is extremely difficult. Harvard Business School professor Andy Wu bluntly called it “the hardest CEO role to fill in at least the past 10 to 20 years.” He noted that AI investment inherently involves risk and that such seemingly irrational bets require a leader with founder‑level control and charisma to communicate flexibly with investors and inspire employees to pursue visions that outsiders might deem almost absurd.

For now, Nvidia’s chief financial officer Colette Kress has stepped in as interim CEO, and the board has launched a formal search for a permanent chief executive, considering both internal and external candidates. The company, whose identity is deeply intertwined with Huang’s personal vision and charisma, is now officially entering an unknown “post‑Huang” era.

items.title: 黃仁勳辭任獲矽谷大咖聲援！馬斯克、Gavin Baker、Epic Games執行長批輝達董事會
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Resigns, Receives Backing from Silicon Valley Heavyweights: Musk, Gavin Baker, and Epic Games CEO Criticize Nvidia Board
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳辭職後，矽谷多名企業領袖與投資人接連公開表態支持，認為黃仁勳是公司難以取代的核心人物，若他離開，恐動搖輝達與人工智慧（AI）產業之間的合作關係，甚至影響美國在AI競賽中的地位。
根據《紐約時報》報導，黃仁勳上周四（12日）辭去輝達執行長職務，此前傳出他與一名公司員工及一名中國女性有染。消息曝光後，多名科技業高層、投資人及新創企業領袖透過社群平台發文或致函董事會，要求重新考慮黃仁勳的去留，並質疑董事會是否迫於外界壓力做出決定。
SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長、全球首富馬斯克周六（14日）在社群平台表示，黃仁勳在輝達供應鏈管理方面表現出色，許多交易仰賴雙方握手達成，而非正式書面合約。
他直言，少了黃仁勳，至少部分關鍵交易可能無法延續。
Altimeter Capital Management執行長Brad Gerstner與Atreides Management首席投資長Gavin Baker周五（13日）亦致函輝達董事會，指出倉促更換黃仁勳並不符合股東最大利益，要求董事會考慮所有可能選項，包括讓黃仁勳重新出任執行長。
另一封名為《與黃仁勳站在一起》的公開信，則直接要求輝達董事會重新任命黃仁勳為執行長、展開獨立調查，並對相關事件作出說明。
截至周六（14日）上午，該信已獲得近10萬人簽署，支持者包括輝達現任與前任員工、馬斯克等商業夥伴，以及創投公司Y Combinator執行長Garry Tan等新創業界人士與股東。
這波聲援也凸顯黃仁勳在AI產業中的影響力。輝達從早期生產電玩用晶片起家，如今已掌握美國大型AI計畫所使用的先進晶片市場90%。隨著公司成長為全球市值最高的企業之一，黃仁勳也成為矽谷重要的交易推手，協助需要晶片與資金的新創企業建立合作關係。
部分企業領袖對輝達董事會的批評更為直接。通訊應用程式Telegram執行長杜羅夫（Pavel Durov）周五在社群平台發文，認為黃仁勳犯下新手錯誤，並藉此提醒創辦人應掌握董事會主導權。
電玩公司Epic Games執行長史威尼（Tim Sweeney）周四則批評輝達董事會存在嚴重的公司治理問題。他在黃仁勳辭職前一天曾表示，如果董事會撤換黃仁勳，將是如同蘋果(AAPL-US) 當年解雇賈伯斯般愚蠢的決定。
1985年，蘋果董事會曾罷免共同創辦人賈伯斯（Steve Jobs），直到1997年他才重返公司，再度出任執行長。
創投家Elad Gil也在周四發文指出，黃仁勳辭職為所有創辦人敲響警鐘，應重新檢視董事會成員組成。他建議創辦人應趁公司順利時調整董事會，以免在情勢不利時遭遇突如其來的變動。
Uber (UBER-US) 共同創辦人、前執行長卡蘭尼克（Travis Kalanick）的經歷，也成為外界討論的案例。2017年，優步面臨日益嚴重的法律與道德爭議，公司最大投資人要求卡蘭尼克辭職；他離開執行長職位後，便未再回到優步。
paras_en: After Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, numerous Silicon Valley business leaders and investors publicly voiced support, saying Huang is an irreplaceable core figure for the company and that his departure could jeopardize Nvidia's collaborations with the artificial intelligence (AI) industry and even affect the United States' standing in the AI race.

According to the New York Times, Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO last Thursday (the 12th) following rumors of an affair with a company employee and a Chinese woman. After the story broke, many tech executives, investors and startup leaders posted on social media or wrote letters to the board urging a reconsideration of Huang's exit and questioning whether the board yielded to external pressure.

SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO and world’s richest man Elon Musk posted on social media on Saturday (the 14th) that Huang excelled at managing Nvidia’s supply chain, noting that many deals rely on a handshake between the parties rather than formal written contracts.
He stated plainly that without Huang, at least some key transactions might not be able to continue.

Altimeter Capital Management CEO Brad Gerstner and Atreides Management chief investment officer Gavin Baker also wrote to Nvidia’s board on Friday (the 13th), arguing that a rushed replacement of Huang does not serve shareholders’ best interests and urging the board to consider all options, including reinstating Huang as CEO.
Another open letter titled “Standing with Jensen Huang” directly called on Nvidia’s board to re‑appoint Huang as CEO, launch an independent investigation, and provide an explanation of the incident.

By Saturday morning (the 14th), the letter had been signed by nearly 100,000 people, including current and former Nvidia employees, business partners such as Musk, and startup community figures and shareholders like Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan.

The wave of support also highlights Huang’s influence in the AI sector. Nvidia, which began by making chips for video games, now controls about 90% of the advanced chip market used in large U.S. AI projects. As the company has grown into one of the world’s most valuable firms, Huang has become a key deal‑maker in Silicon Valley, helping chip‑ and capital‑hungry startups forge partnerships.

Some business leaders were more blunt in their criticism of Nvidia’s board. Telegram founder Pavel Durov posted on social media on Friday, saying Huang made a rookie mistake and using the episode to remind founders to retain control over their boards.

Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney criticized Nvidia’s board on Thursday, saying it suffers from serious corporate‑governance problems. He had warned the day before Huang’s resignation that removing him would be as foolish as Apple (AAPL-US) firing Steve Jobs.
In 1985 Apple’s board ousted co‑founder Steve Jobs, who did not return to the company until 1997, when he was reinstated as CEO.

Venture capitalist Elad Gil also posted on Thursday that Huang’s resignation should sound an alarm for all founders, urging a review of board composition. He suggested founders adjust their boards while the company is thriving to avoid sudden upheavals when conditions turn adverse.

The experience of Uber (UBER-US) co‑founder and former CEO Travis Kalanick is also being cited. In 2017 Uber faced mounting legal and ethical controversies, and its largest investor demanded Kalanick’s resignation; after stepping down as CEO he never returned to the company.

items.title: 《金融時報》黃仁勳辭任牽動AI資金鏈！輝達投資逾千億美元、深度綁定新創與雲端業者
items.title_en: Financial Times: Jensen Huang’s Resignation Could Ripple Through AI Funding Chains! Nvidia Invests Over $100 B, Deeply Tied to Start‑ups and Cloud Players
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳辭任，不僅讓公司面臨接班問題，也可能牽動他多年來親自推動的人工智慧（AI）產業投資與融資網絡。在他的主導下，輝達將龐大利潤投入AI新創、供應商及晶片客戶，並透過股權投資、採購承諾、租賃合約與財務擔保，協助合作夥伴取得資金、算力及資料中心資源。隨著黃仁勳離開，這套彼此緊密連結的資金布局能否延續，成為AI產業的新變數。
根據《金融時報》報導，黃仁勳33年前共同創立輝達，長期親自參與公司重大投資與交易。據曾接受輝達投資的企業創辦人透露，儘管他有數十名直接下屬，仍會介入多筆規模達數十億美元的投資案，從資金挹注到商業合作都親自掌握。
黃仁勳上個月在倫敦一場活動中，曾向合作夥伴形容輝達的投資角色：「我們不是你們最大的投資人，但我們是最好的投資人。」
分析指出，這反映出輝達近年在AI產業中的定位，已不只是晶片供應商，更成為支撐新創企業與基礎設施建設的重要資金來源。

從投資新創到提供融資擔保 輝達深度介入AI產業

輝達的資金支持涵蓋AI產業多個環節。
去年，雲端運算業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 上市計畫遭遇挫折時，黃仁勳帶領輝達提供關鍵採購訂單，協助公司度過難關；OpenAI計畫在美國俄亥俄州興建大型資料中心園區時，輝達也承諾提供最高1,050億美元的租賃及電力費用擔保。
此外，黃仁勳還與華爾街金融機構合作，規劃運用輝達資產負債表，為晶片融資籌集超過5,000億美元的外部資金。知情人士透露，目前已有多筆相關交易正在進行。
輝達也計畫在Anthropic上市前，透過私募方式投資100億美元。隨著投資、融資及財務擔保規模迅速擴大，輝達已在今年8月底提交的季度財報中新增風險揭露，警告相關承諾與擔保可能帶來財務、交易對手及執行風險，且未必能實現預期效益。
Bernstein分析師在調降輝達目標價時，也對公司在相關領域的投資、各類備援資金安排及未履行擔保提出疑問。
根據PitchBook資料，輝達及旗下創投部門今年以來已進行超過120筆投資，平均約每兩天半就投資一家企業。截至7月底，包含已承諾但尚未完成的投資在內，輝達股權投資規模已達1,240億美元。
投資追蹤平台Dealroom的資料則顯示，輝達的相關布局包括總額達350億美元的計畫收購與人才延攬，例如Hugging Face及Groq；持有英特爾(INTC-US) 、諾基亞(NOK-US) 等上市公司合計230億美元股權；另向200多家新創企業投入超過600億美元，投資對象包括OpenAI、Anthropic及馬斯克旗下的xAI。
黃仁勳上個月在歐洲巡迴期間也表示，輝達過去一年已向歐洲投入80億美元，並承諾再投入20億美元。他稱，輝達作為歐洲AI產業的「錨定投資者」，已為當地帶來高達600億美元的後續資金，並創造數千個工作機會。

新雲業者成投資重心 輝達藉資金布局鎖定晶片需求

輝達扶植的對象中，新興AI雲端服務商（Neocloud）尤其受惠。這類業者專門出租AI運算資源，除了大量採購輝達晶片，也讓AI企業有機會降低對大型雲端服務商的依賴。大型雲端業者近年則愈來愈積極自行設計處理器。
PitchBook資料顯示，輝達今年至少與新雲業者及其他AI基礎設施公司達成15筆交易，相關融資輪總額達240億美元。不過，一名新雲業者高層表示，預期在黃仁勳相關風波平息之前，輝達的投資交易活動將大致停滯。
除了直接投資股權，黃仁勳也推動輝達進一步協助新雲業者取得融資、資料中心空間及電力供應，藉此支持合作夥伴擴張，同時確保輝達晶片的市場需求。
截至7月底，輝達已承諾向AI雲端業者採購價值360億美元的運算能力，若相關業者無法找到其他客戶，輝達將承接這些算力。這類合約也能作為業者向金融機構貸款、購買輝達晶片的擔保基礎。
輝達另簽署價值200億美元的資料中心租賃協議，並計畫將部分空間轉租給其他企業。其中包括位於德州、容量達1吉瓦的資料中心園區，輝達已將部分空間轉租給旗下支持的新雲業者Lambda。Lambda將使用採購自輝達的晶片，為Anthropic提供運算服務。
輝達規模最大的一筆財務擔保，則涉及OpenAI在俄亥俄州興建的資料中心園區。該園區總容量達4.25吉瓦，由軟銀投資的SB Energy負責開發。輝達提供最高1,050億美元的信貸支持，協助SB Energy籌措建設資金；作為交換，園區未來20年將獨家使用輝達硬體。
黃仁勳當時表示，資料中心已成為輝達必須確保供應的下一項關鍵資源，公司正以管理晶片供應相同的紀律，確保AI資料中心所需的土地、電力及廠房容量。他也強調，這並非循環融資，因為OpenAI仍會支付租金。
黃仁勳上個月在倫敦活動中，還曾半開玩笑地向接受輝達資金支持的企業負責人重申合作關係中的責任。他引用已故創投家、紅杉資本創辦人瓦倫丁（Don Valentine）過去給他的建議：「如果你讓我賠錢，我會殺了你。」
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation not only creates a succession issue for the company but could also disturb the AI industry investment and financing network he has personally built over years. Under his leadership, Nvidia poured massive profits into AI start‑ups, suppliers and chip customers, using equity stakes, purchase commitments, leasing contracts and financial guarantees to help partners secure capital, compute power and data‑center resources. With Huang’s departure, whether this tightly interwoven funding structure can continue becomes a new variable for the AI sector.

According to the Financial Times, Huang co‑founded Nvidia 33 years ago and has long been directly involved in the company’s major investments and deals. Founders of firms that have received Nvidia funding say that despite having dozens of direct reports, Huang still gets involved in multiple multi‑billion‑dollar investment projects, overseeing everything from capital infusion to commercial collaboration himself.
At a London event last month, Huang described Nvidia’s investment role to partners: “We’re not your biggest investor, but we’re the best investor.”
Analysts note that this reflects Nvidia’s evolving position in the AI ecosystem: it is no longer just a chip supplier but also a crucial source of capital for start‑ups and infrastructure building.
From start‑up investments to financing guarantees, Nvidia is deeply embedded in the AI industry.

Last year, when cloud‑computing provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) hit a snag in its IPO plan, Huang led Nvidia to provide a critical purchase order that helped the company survive; when OpenAI planned a large data‑center campus in Ohio, Nvidia pledged up to $105 billion in leasing and power‑cost guarantees.

Huang also teamed up with Wall Street banks to leverage Nvidia’s balance sheet to raise more than $500 billion of external funding for chip financing, insiders say, and several related transactions are already underway.

Nvidia also plans to invest $10 billion in Anthropic via a private placement before its IPO. As investment, financing and guarantee activities have rapidly expanded, Nvidia added a new risk disclosure in its Q3 report filed at the end of August, warning that such commitments and guarantees may entail financial, counter‑party and execution risks and may not deliver the expected benefits.

When Bernstein analysts cut Nvidia’s target price, they questioned the company’s investments in these areas, its various backup‑funding arrangements and the possibility that some guarantees might not be fulfilled.

PitchBook data shows Nvidia and its venture‑capital arm have made over 120 investments this year, roughly one investment every two and a half days. By the end of July, including pledged but not yet completed deals, Nvidia’s equity‑investment portfolio had reached $124 billion.

Dealroom data indicates Nvidia’s related activities include $35 billion in planned acquisitions and talent‑acquisition deals, such as Hugging Face and Groq; holdings in listed companies like Intel (INTC-US) and Nokia (NOK-US) totalling $23 billion; and more than $60 billion invested in over 200 start‑ups, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Elon Musk’s xAI.

During his recent European tour, Huang said Nvidia has put $8 billion into Europe over the past year and pledged another $2 billion. He called Nvidia a “anchor investor” for Europe’s AI industry, noting it has spurred up to $60 billion of downstream funding and created thousands of jobs locally.

New cloud providers have become a key investment focus, with Nvidia’s backing locking in chip demand. Among the companies Nvidia nurtures, emerging AI cloud services firms (Neocloud) benefit especially, as they rent AI compute resources, buy large volumes of Nvidia chips and give AI firms a way to reduce reliance on big cloud providers, which are increasingly designing their own processors.

PitchBook shows Nvidia has completed at least 15 deals this year with new cloud providers and other AI infrastructure firms, totaling $24 billion in financing rounds. However, a senior executive at a new cloud firm said they expect Nvidia’s investment activity to largely stall until the Huang saga settles down.
Beyond equity stakes, Huang has pushed Nvidia to help new cloud players secure financing, data‑center space and power supply, supporting partners’ expansion while ensuring demand for Nvidia chips.

By the end of July, Nvidia had committed to purchase $36 billion of compute capacity from AI cloud providers; if those providers cannot find other customers, Nvidia will take over the compute power. Such contracts also serve as collateral for the providers’ loans and chip purchases.

Nvidia also signed a $20 billion data‑center leasing deal and plans to sub‑lease part of the space to other firms, including a 1‑GW Texas data‑center campus where it has sub‑leased space to its supported new‑cloud partner Lambda, which will use Nvidia‑sourced chips to run services for Anthropic.

Nvidia’s largest financial guarantee involves OpenAI’s Ohio data‑center campus, a 4.25‑GW facility developed by SB Energy, a SoftBank‑backed investor. Nvidia is providing up to $105 billion in credit support to help SB Energy raise construction funds; in return, the campus will exclusively use Nvidia hardware for the next 20 years.

Huang said data‑centers have become the next critical resource Nvidia must secure, and the company is managing them with the same discipline it applies to chip supply, ensuring land, power and facility capacity for AI data‑centers. He stressed this is not a circular financing arrangement because OpenAI will still pay rent.

At the London event last month, Huang half‑jokingly reminded executives of companies receiving Nvidia funding of their responsibilities in the partnership, quoting the late venture‑capitalist and Sequoia founder Don Valentine: “If you make me lose money, I’ll kill you.”

items.title: 黃仁勳辭任後摩根士丹利下修輝達目標價！2028會計年度營收成長預測從70%砍至53.5%
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Steps Down, Morgan Stanley Cuts Nvidia Target Price; FY2028 Data Center Revenue Growth Forecast Trimmed from 70% to 53.5%
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳辭任，加上美國可能進一步收緊晶片出口限制，摩根士丹利下修輝達未來兩個會計年度的資料中心營收預測，將2028會計年度營收成長率預估從原先的70%降至53.5%，目標價也由300美元調降至267美元。不過，該行維持輝達「增持」評級。
摩根士丹利在11月13日發布的報告中指出，黃仁勳辭任是輝達面臨的一大挫折。過去十年，公司在硬體、軟體、網路、運算及儲存領域持續創新，並以快速決策、積極管理供應鏈，以及與客戶、投資人和員工保持密切溝通為特色，這些都與黃仁勳的領導風格密不可分。
輝達目前由財務長克瑞斯（Colette Kress）暫代執行長一職，正式接班人選尚未確定。摩根士丹利認為，克瑞斯是能力出色的財務長，應能協助公司平穩度過過渡期，但臨時執行長的身分，可能使輝達在對客戶做出長期承諾、籌組大型融資銀團，以及凝聚內部策略共識時面臨挑戰。
該行指出，人工智慧（AI）晶片產業變化迅速，輝達的決策又涉及產能安排、融資及客戶交付時程，因此盡快確定正式執行長應是公司優先事項。

接班人選未定 產品與供應鏈布局仍提供支撐

摩根士丹利目前聽到最多的內部接班人選，是負責資料中心業務的巴克（Ian Buck）。他與客戶、供應鏈夥伴及部分投資人已有一定熟悉度，但該行尚無法判斷他若接任執行長，將採取何種策略，也不確定他本人是否有意願接掌公司。
除了克瑞斯和巴克，該行也聽聞其他內部及外部人選，認為這些候選人各有能力，關鍵在於誰最符合輝達的長期策略目標。此外，輝達董事會具備半導體專業背景的成員有限，也可能讓接班人選的評估需要更多時間。
儘管領導層出現變動，摩根士丹利認為，輝達近期的產品與供應鏈規劃仍相對穩固。新一代平台Vera Rubin正逐步放量，該行從客戶端獲得的回饋顯示，這套平台在每吉瓦電力可產生的Token數量上仍具領先優勢。
Token是AI模型處理及生成內容的計量單位，也是雲端服務業者向客戶收費的依據。在資料中心電力供應受限的情況下，每單位電力能產生越多Token，業者可提供及銷售的運算服務就越多。
至於下一代Rubin Ultra，摩根士丹利表示，產品規格已大致定案。輝達也透過預付款，鎖定未來兩年的多數關鍵零組件產能，其中未來12個月的短缺零組件大多已獲得保障。
對於市場擔心黃仁勳離任後，輝達在供應鏈管理上可能不再維持過去積極的作風，摩根士丹利認為這項疑慮被過度放大，理由是公司已透過預付款確保相當程度的供應。不過，兩年保障期之後的供應鏈策略仍有待觀察。
該行另引述未具名消息來源指出，輝達員工雖然對黃仁勳辭任感到震驚，但目前已逐漸穩定，工作重心仍放在既有任務上。

美國出口限制可能收緊 海外雲端中國模型業務成變數

除了接班問題，美國可能進一步收緊晶片出口限制，也是摩根士丹利下修預測的另一項原因。
該行觀察到，美國方面本周加快討論擴大出口限制，可能將中國AI模型透過海外雲端服務租用運算資源的業務納入管制。目前這類交易在多數情況下仍獲允許，若相關規定收緊，可能影響輝達晶片需求。
不過，摩根士丹利認為，潛在衝擊可能受到兩項因素緩衝。首先，海外雲端平台提供給中國模型的算力，主要用於推理服務，若這部分Token需求減少，其他開放權重模型的需求可能填補部分缺口。其次，AI運算需求目前仍遠高於供給，若部分硬體需求消失，相關產能也可能很快轉由其他客戶吸收。
輝達先前提出2027年約70%的成長指引時，也曾表示市場需求增幅超過100%。摩根士丹利認為，需求成長與公司指引之間的差距，意味著部分需求放緩仍有機會被市場消化。
此外，美國也在討論限制透過未經授權管道流通的GPU，但摩根士丹利認為這部分市場規模相對有限。不過，相關規定的最終適用範圍尚未明朗，該行因此先在財務模型中納入較保守的假設。

新雲收入分成計畫料續行 資金可能流向大型業者

輝達近年積極布局新興雲端（Neocloud）業者，也就是專門出租AI運算資源的新型雲端服務商。公司推動的收入分成計畫，是由輝達承擔部分風險並協助籌組銀團融資，藉此分享雲端服務商的利潤。
黃仁勳曾表示，2027自然年新雲業者約80%的收入，也就是每5吉瓦新增運算容量中的4吉瓦，將採用收入分成模式。
摩根士丹利認為，這項計畫應能延續。克瑞斯曾參與計畫規劃，且最初介紹該安排的文章也由她執筆，因此有能力繼續推動。不過，該行擔心，執行長人事尚未明朗，可能讓規模較小的新雲業者更難取得占融資多數的資金。
同時，輝達先前募集的5,000億美元第三方資金池，資金可能因此更傾向流向規模較大、營運較成熟的客戶，尤其是大型雲端服務商。摩根士丹利仍預估新雲業者將貢獻輝達近25%的營收，但其中來自成熟業者的比重可能提高。

CUDA競爭優勢受質疑 摩根士丹利認為市場反應過度

近期有客戶的發言，再度引發市場對輝達CUDA軟體平台競爭優勢是否正在減弱的討論。CUDA長期被視為輝達吸引開發者、建立軟體生態系的重要關鍵。
不過，摩根士丹利認為，市場對這項議題的關注程度過高。該行指出，大型尖端模型業者早已採取不受特定晶片架構綁定的策略，因此CUDA對這類客戶的影響力，早在數年前就已不再是決定性因素。
在這些客戶眼中，輝達的主要優勢仍來自晶片本身較高的每吉瓦Token產出能力，以及完整的軟硬體生態系。
摩根士丹利並指出，從2022年至本周之前，市場幾乎沒有再大規模討論CUDA是否構成競爭壁壘，但輝達的營收市占率仍維持在80%以上。

2028、2029會計年度預測下修 2028會計年度營收成長降至53.5%

在財務預測方面，摩根士丹利將輝達2028及2029會計年度的資料中心營收預測各下修約10%，主要反映美國進一步收緊出口限制的風險；2027會計年度剩餘季度的預測則維持不變。
輝達會計年度截至次年1月，因此2028會計年度大致對應2027自然年。摩根士丹利將2028會計年度營收預測下調9.7%，每股盈餘預測下修10.9%；2029會計年度營收預測則下調10.7%，每股盈餘同樣下修10.9%。
此次調整主要集中在資料中心營收規模，毛利率預測僅下修0.09個百分點。摩根士丹利並未進一步拆分營收下修中，出貨量與價格各自占多少影響。
以2028會計年度季度預測來看，下修幅度主要集中在下半年。第三季每股盈餘預測由3.98美元降至3.49美元，第四季則由4.78美元降至3.78美元；上半年調整相對有限，第一季由2.90美元微調至2.88美元，第二季則由3.36美元降至3.23美元。
摩根士丹利坦言，這次預測採取較保守的假設，將2028會計年度營收成長率從原先的70%降至53.5%，明顯低於輝達提出的70%出貨成長指引。該行預期，輝達可能在下周財報電話會議上重申這項指引，但在美國出口限制新規正式出爐前，仍決定對成長數字保留折扣。
摩根士丹利表示，11月12日已有十多家機構下調輝達評級，雖然該行本身也不確定是否確實有必要下修預測，但在政策走向不明的情況下，選擇先採取較低的估值與獲利假設。
這次調整也大致抵銷摩根士丹利8月對輝達財測的上修。當時，輝達將2027自然年成長框架提高至約70%，摩根士丹利隨後將2028會計年度營收預測從5,988億美元上調至6,902億美元，每股盈餘預測從13.15美元提高至15.01美元，目標價也由288美元升至300美元。
如今，該行將2028會計年度營收預測調整至6,229.81億美元，每股盈餘預測降至13.37美元，成長率則回到53.5%，與8月調高預測前的水準相差不大。換言之，摩根士丹利目前的獲利預估，已大致回到輝達提出70%成長框架前的基準。
不過，目標價從先前的288美元降至267美元，跌幅更大。摩根士丹利指出，8月上修預測時，已將估值倍數從22倍下調至20倍，因此這次目標價進一步下修，也反映估值假設的變化。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang resigned, and with the United States possibly tightening chip export restrictions, Morgan Stanley lowered its data‑center revenue forecasts for Nvidia’s next two fiscal years, cutting the FY2028 revenue growth estimate from the original 70% to 53.5% and reducing the target price from $300 to $267. The firm, however, kept its "overweight" rating on Nvidia.

Morgan Stanley’s November 13 report said Huang’s departure is a major setback for Nvidia. Over the past decade the company has continuously innovated across hardware, software, networking, computing and storage, and has been characterized by rapid decision‑making, proactive supply‑chain management, and close communication with customers, investors and employees – all closely tied to Huang’s leadership style.

Nvidia is currently being run on an interim basis by CFO Colette Kress, with a permanent successor not yet identified. Morgan Stanley believes Kress is a highly capable CFO who should help the company navigate the transition smoothly, but her temporary CEO status could make it harder for Nvidia to make long‑term commitments to customers, assemble large financing syndicates, and build internal strategic consensus.

The firm noted that the AI chip industry evolves quickly, and Nvidia’s decisions involve capacity planning, financing and customer delivery schedules, so appointing a permanent CEO should be a top priority for the company.

Succession Uncertain, Product and Supply‑Chain Plans Remain a Support The most frequently mentioned internal candidate at Morgan Stanley is Ian Buck, who runs the data‑center business. He is familiar with customers, supply‑chain partners and some investors, but the firm cannot determine what strategy he would pursue if he became CEO, nor whether he is interested in the role.

In addition to Kress and Buck, Morgan Stanley has heard of other internal and external candidates, each of whom has merit; the key will be who best aligns with Nvidia’s long‑term strategic goals. The board’s limited semiconductor expertise may also lengthen the evaluation process for a successor.

Despite the leadership change, Morgan Stanley believes Nvidia’s recent product and supply‑chain planning remains relatively solid. The next‑generation Vera Rubin platform is ramping up, and feedback from customers indicates the platform still leads in token output per gigawatt of power.

A token is the unit used to measure AI model processing and content generation, and it is the basis for cloud providers’ billing to customers. When data‑center power is constrained, generating more tokens per unit of power allows providers to deliver and sell more compute services.

Regarding the upcoming Rubin Ultra generation, Morgan Stanley says the product specifications are largely finalized. Nvidia has also secured most of the key component capacity for the next two years through advance payments, and most short‑term component shortages for the coming 12 months have been mitigated.

Morgan Stanley thinks concerns that Nvidia may become less aggressive in supply‑chain management after Huang’s exit are overstated, because the company has already used advance payments to lock in a substantial portion of supply. However, the post‑two‑year supply‑chain strategy remains to be seen.
The firm also cited an unnamed source saying Nvidia staff were shocked by Huang’s resignation but have largely stabilized, with work focus still on existing tasks.

U.S. Export Restrictions May Tighten, Overseas Cloud China Model Business Becomes a Variable In addition to the succession issue, a possible further tightening of U.S. chip export restrictions is another reason Morgan Stanley trimmed its forecasts.

Morgan Stanley observed that U.S. officials this week accelerated discussions on expanding export controls, potentially bringing AI model workloads run on overseas cloud services for China under regulation. Most such transactions are still permitted, but tighter rules could affect demand for Nvidia chips.

The firm believes two factors could cushion any impact. First, overseas cloud platforms provide compute for Chinese models mainly for inference; if token demand from that segment falls, demand for open‑weight models could fill part of the gap. Second, AI compute demand still far exceeds supply, so any loss of hardware demand would likely be absorbed quickly by other customers.

When Nvidia previously gave a roughly 70% growth outlook for 2027, it also said market demand was increasing by more than 100%. Morgan Stanley sees the gap between demand growth and the company’s guidance as indicating that some slowdown could still be absorbed by the market.

The United States is also discussing limits on GPUs flowing through unauthorized channels, but Morgan Stanley thinks that market is relatively small. The final scope of such rules is still unclear, so the firm has incorporated more conservative assumptions into its financial model.

New Cloud Revenue‑Sharing Program Expected to Continue, Funding May Flow to Larger Players Nvidia has been actively courting emerging “Neocloud” providers—new cloud services that rent AI compute resources. The company’s revenue‑sharing program involves Nvidia taking on part of the risk and helping arrange syndicate financing to share profits with the cloud providers.
Huang said that in calendar year 2027 about 80% of revenue from new cloud players—equivalent to 4 GW of the 5 GW of new compute capacity—will be under the revenue‑sharing model.

Morgan Stanley believes the program should continue. Kress participated in its design and authored the initial announcement, so she is well‑placed to keep it going. However, the firm worries that an unclear CEO succession could make it harder for smaller new‑cloud players to secure a majority of financing.

At the same time, Nvidia’s previously raised $500 billion third‑party funding pool may tilt more toward larger, more mature customers, especially big cloud providers. Morgan Stanley still expects new‑cloud players to contribute roughly 25% of Nvidia’s revenue, but the share coming from mature providers could rise.

CUDA Competitive Edge Questioned, Morgan Stanley Says Market Overreacted Recent customer comments have revived debate over whether Nvidia’s CUDA software platform is losing its competitive edge. CUDA has long been a key factor in attracting developers and building Nvidia’s software ecosystem.

Morgan Stanley thinks market attention to this issue is excessive. The firm notes that large‑scale cutting‑edge model developers have already adopted hardware‑agnostic strategies, so CUDA’s influence on these customers has not been decisive for years.
For these customers, Nvidia’s main advantage remains the chip’s higher token output per gigawatt and its complete hardware‑software ecosystem.
Morgan Stanley also pointed out that from 2022 up to this week, the market has hardly discussed CUDA as a competitive moat, yet Nvidia’s revenue market share stays above 80%.

FY2028 and FY2029 Forecasts Trimmed, FY2028 Revenue Growth to 53.5% In its financial outlook, Morgan Stanley cuts Nvidia’s FY2028 and FY2029 data‑center revenue forecasts by roughly 10% each, mainly reflecting the risk of tighter U.S. export controls; the FY2027 remaining‑quarter outlook is unchanged.

Nvidia’s fiscal year ends in January of the following calendar year, so FY2028 roughly corresponds to calendar 2027. Morgan Stanley lowers the FY2028 revenue forecast by 9.7% and EPS by 10.9%; FY2029 revenue is cut 10.7% with EPS also reduced 10.9%.

The adjustment is focused on data‑center revenue size, with gross‑margin guidance trimmed by only 0.09 percentage points. Morgan Stanley did not break down how much of the revenue cut stems from volume versus price effects.

Looking at quarterly FY2028 forecasts, the cuts are concentrated in the second half. Q3 EPS is revised from $3.98 to $3.49 and Q4 from $4.78 to $3.78; the first half sees modest changes, with Q1 EPS moving from $2.90 to $2.88 and Q2 from $3.36 to $3.23.

Morgan Stanley admits the new outlook uses more conservative assumptions, dropping the FY2028 revenue growth rate from 70% to 53.5%, well below Nvidia’s 70% shipment‑growth guidance. The firm expects Nvidia may reiterate that guidance at next week’s earnings call, but will keep a discount on growth numbers until U.S. export‑control rules are finalized.

On November 12, more than a dozen institutions downgraded Nvidia, and while Morgan Stanley itself is not certain a downgrade is warranted, it chose a lower valuation and profit assumption amid policy uncertainty.

The revision largely offsets Morgan Stanley’s August upgrade to Nvidia’s financials. At that time Nvidia raised its 2027 growth framework to about 70%, and Morgan Stanley lifted FY2028 revenue from $598.8 billion to $690.2 billion, EPS from $13.15 to $15.01, and the target price from $288 to $300.

Now the firm adjusts FY2028 revenue to $622.981 billion, EPS to $13.37, and growth back to 53.5%, a level close to the pre‑August baseline. In other words, Morgan Stanley’s current profit estimate has essentially returned to the baseline before Nvidia’s 70% growth framework was introduced.

However, the target price has fallen from $288 to $267, a larger drop. Morgan Stanley notes that when it upgraded in August it had already reduced the valuation multiple from 22× to 20×, so the further price cut reflects a change in valuation assumptions.

items.title: 伊朗：兩艘油輪在荷姆茲海峽觸雷 引發劇烈爆炸
items.title_en: Iran: Two Tankers Hit Mines in the Strait of Hormuz, Triggering Violent Explosions
paras: 伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊海軍15日（周日）宣布，過去幾小時內，兩艘在荷姆茲海峽南部海域沿未經伊朗授權航線行駛的油輪觸碰水雷，引發劇烈爆炸。
這些油輪在美軍支持下，關閉了所有識別及定位系統，試圖祕密通過海峽。
伊斯蘭革命衛隊稱，其中一艘載有超過200萬桶原油的超級油輪，在爆炸和起火後，已沉沒在波斯灣南部海域。
伊斯蘭革命衛隊建議在上述海域作業的漁民務必採取安全防範措施，避免與這些沉沒油輪的殘骸發生碰撞。
paras_en: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy announced on Sunday the 15th that within the past few hours, two tankers traveling in the southern waters of the Strait of Hormuz along a route not authorized by Iran struck naval mines, causing violent explosions.
The tankers, under U.S. support, had disabled all identification and positioning systems in an attempt to secretly transit the strait.
The IRGC said one of the vessels, a supertanker carrying more than 2 million barrels of crude oil, sank in the southern Persian Gulf after the explosion and fire.
The IRGC urged fishermen operating in the area to take safety precautions and avoid colliding with the wreckage of the sunken tankers.

items.title: Megaspeed發佈聲明！證實黃樂去年8月離職  黃仁勳緋聞牽出國安疑慮
items.title_en: Megaspeed Issues Statement Confirming Alice Huang's August 2025 Resignation; Huang Renxun Romance Sparks National‑Security Concerns
paras: 新加坡雲端運算公司 Megaspeed 周日（15日）發布聲明，證實中國籍商界人士黃樂（Alice Huang）已於2025年8月30日正式離職，目前與公司沒有任何職務關係。黃樂與輝達(NVDA-US) 前執行長黃仁勳的關係，以及她遭美方懷疑涉及中國間諜活動的傳聞，引發美國國安疑慮。
根據《路透》報導，Megaspeed 是輝達在亞太地區的商業合作夥伴。此前有報導指稱，黃仁勳曾與這名前 Megaspeed 高階主管發生婚外情，而美國當局懷疑黃艾莉是中國間諜，使該公司受到外界關注。
Megaspeed 在聲明中表示，不對黃樂的個人及私人事務發表評論。公司也強調，近期媒體報導對其業務、供應鏈及全球營運提出的部分說法，缺乏可查證的證據支持。
《紐約時報》2025年10月報導指出，Megaspeed 正接受美國政府調查，調查重點在於該公司是否協助中國客戶取得受到華府出口管制的輝達晶片。不過，中國已否認相關指控，Megaspeed 迄今也未被認定違反相關規定。
針對相關調查及報導，Megaspeed 表示，公司從事的都是合法合規的商業活動，並已聘請外部法律顧問展開全面內部調查。
公司也指出，其營運及供應鏈管控機制均以遵守適用法律與法規為設計原則，包括美國出口管制規定。
根據華府研究機構 C4ADS 檢視企業登記資料後發布的資訊，黃樂於2023年3月成為 Megaspeed 控股股東。
《路透》就 Megaspeed 的聲明向美國政府及輝達尋求評論，但雙方均未立即回覆。
paras_en: Singapore cloud‑computing firm Megaspeed issued a statement on Sunday (the 15th) confirming that Chinese businessperson Alice Huang resigned on August 30, 2025, and currently holds no position with the company. Huang's relationship with Nvidia (NVDA-US) former CEO Jensen Huang, and rumors that she is suspected by U.S. authorities of involvement in Chinese espionage, have raised U.S. national‑security concerns.

According to Reuters, Megaspeed is Nvidia’s commercial partner in the Asia‑Pacific region. Earlier reports alleged that Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair with the former Megaspeed senior executive, and U.S. officials suspect Alice Huang of being a Chinese spy, drawing external scrutiny to the firm.

In its statement, Megaspeed said it would not comment on Huang’s personal or private matters. The company also emphasized that recent media reports containing certain claims about its business, supply chain, and global operations lack verifiable evidence.

A New York Times report from October 2025 noted that Megaspeed is under investigation by the U.S. government, focusing on whether the company helped Chinese customers obtain Nvidia chips subject to U.S. export controls. China has denied the allegations, and Megaspeed has not yet been found to have violated any regulations.

Regarding the investigation and media coverage, Megaspeed said that all its activities are lawful and compliant, and that it has hired external legal counsel to conduct a comprehensive internal review.
The company also pointed out that its operational and supply‑chain control mechanisms are designed to comply with all applicable laws and regulations, including U.S. export‑control rules.
Based on information released by the Washington‑based research organization C4ADS after reviewing corporate registration data, Alice Huang became a controlling shareholder of Megaspeed in March 2023.
Reuters sought comments from the U.S. government and Nvidia on Megaspeed’s statement, but neither party responded immediately.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：AI交易關鍵時刻！輝達首份無黃仁勳財報、Anthropic重磅IPO 「川習普」三方會議登場
items.title_en: This Week's Trading Notes: Pivotal Moment for AI Trading! Nvidia’s First Earnings Without Jensen Huang, Anthropic’s Major IPO, and the “Trump‑Xi‑Putin” Trilateral Meeting
paras: 本週國際大事包括輝達第3季財報，這家人工智慧(AI)晶片巨頭將在黃仁勳閃辭執行長及股價重挫之際舉行財報電話會議，而市場高度期待的AI新創Anthropic終於要掛牌上市，這兩個重大事件將考驗AI交易能否續航。此外，美國總統川普週四將與中國國家主席習近平、俄羅斯總統普丁舉行三方會談，這將是川習兩人今年第三度面對面會晤。

1、輝達首份無黃仁勳財報

黃仁勳卸職執行長後的輝達(NVDA-US)首場財報電話會議預定週二(17日)盤後登場，將由先前擔任財務長的臨時執行長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)主持。
分析師預期，第3季營收估年增約90%至1090億美元，EPS估2.46美元。儘管市場認為這份財報仍將交出亮眼成績，但投資人更關注黃仁勳離職後的領導真空、成長預測是否有變化、AI融資承諾會否延續等問題。
分析師也好奇，輝達管理層是否會大舉實施庫藏股以支撐股價，該公司截至9月底還有2,350億美元的回購授權額度。
輝達股價上週累計下跌13%，連續第六週收黑，創2012年以來最長連跌紀錄，上週五收盤市值已跌破4兆美元。專家表示，考量到輝達目前籠罩在不確定性之中，如果財報表現不如預期，市場施加的任何懲罰都會被放大。
輝達有「AI中央銀行」之稱，大規模提供資金支持客戶擴建、資金又透過晶片採購流回輝達的「循環融資」模式，一直受到關注。華爾街日報(WSJ)報導，幾個月前，克瑞斯和黃仁勳對「循環融資」的安排有不同意見。這導致市場更加關注，輝達未來是否會繼續以大規模融資帶動晶片銷售。
專家表示，這場財報會議的考驗不只在單季數字，黃仁勳離任後，克瑞斯需要讓投資人相信，輝達仍能維持執行力、財務紀律與客戶關係，並在領導交接期間持續推進AI產品路線。

2、Anthropic上市

Anthropic(ANT-US)預定週三(18日)為首次公開發行(IPO)定價，每股估落在70-78美元，接著週四在那斯達克以代碼「ANT」掛牌交易。該公司及部分投資人計劃出售8.25億股股票，最多募資644億美元，估值最高可達1.4兆美元。
在Anthropic之前，馬斯克旗下SpaceX(SPCX-US)今年6月也曾風光IPO，當時以近1.75兆美元估值募到750億美元。但SpaceX上市後走勢顛簸，目前股價僅略高於135美元的IPO發行價，8月更曾跌到約105美元。
Madison Investments首席投資策略師Patrick Ryan表示，如果Anthropic上市後表現不佳，可能釋出另一個警訊，凸顯投資人對AI交易的壓力正在增加。
Peter Thiel家族辦公室管理合夥人Jack Selby也警告，若這樁備受期待的AI大型IPO定價遠低於市場原先預期，或掛牌後表現疲弱，可能加劇AI股修正。
值得注意的是，由於輝達已意在Anthropic IPO同步進行的私募配售中認購約100億美元股票，如今黃仁勳離任，投資人正密切觀察是否波及這項投資承諾。

3、川習普三方會議

白宮已確認，美國總統川普、中國國家主席習近平與俄羅斯總統普丁，將於週四(19日)在深圳舉行的亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)場邊舉行三方會談。這將是川習今年第三度面對面會晤。
川普計劃與習近平、普丁討論伊朗戰事，但將避開烏克蘭議題。一名白宮官員說，三方會談旨在開啟核裁軍對話，是「希望往後能有成果的對話的開端」，但不預期會宣布任何協議。分析師指出，外界對會談成果的預期偏低，象徵意義大於實質。
另外，隨著民主黨在美國期中選舉勝出，可能強化中國在貿易談判中的籌碼，也可能促使民主黨向川普施壓，要求解凍對台軍售案。
至於輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳的婚外情風波是否影響美中晶片議題，白宮官員表示，輝達的情況不應對這趟訪問造成任何影響，美國不會把出口管制的執行拿來與外國談判，川普也不打算就此事質問習近平。
白宮官員也透露，特斯拉(TSLA-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克將隨同川普前往中國深圳，出席APEC峰會。

4、Fed會議紀錄、華許主持AI小組會議

聯準會(Fed)週三將公布10月會議紀錄，Fed在該次會議上按兵不動，但近來多名Fed官員都有擔憂通膨升溫的鷹派發言，加上10月消費者物價指數(CPI)顯示通膨加速升溫，市場更加肯定12月升息的可能性，甚至開始關注明年1月是否可能連續升息。
如果Fed真的在12月和1月接連升息，將是2023年以來首次連續升息。投資人原本只預期12月與明年3月升息，但上週起已反映對12月、明年1月及3月各升息1碼的預期。
本週仍有多名Fed官員將發表演說，至於Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)，自10月決策會後記者會後便未再公開發言。他預定週一為他成立的AI與生產力工作小組主持會議，外界普遍不預期他會偏離多次表明的立場，也就是不對近期貨幣政策走向提供任何前瞻指引。

5、油價走勢

中東外交局勢預期轉變，加上美國需求降溫，正在促使國際油價下跌，但過程並不平順。
油價上週出現雙位數跌幅，已跌到每桶約90美元的兩個月低點，在北半球許多地區準備迎接寒冬之際，油價下跌可能有助於減輕政策制定者與家庭面臨的通膨壓力。
然而，近期由伊朗支持的葉門青年運動(Houthis)攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯基礎設施、運載原油駛離波灣的油輪頻繁遇襲，以及俄羅斯持續受到供應干擾，都讓市場意識到，任何新的供應中斷都可能迅速重新推升油價壓力。
paras_en: This week’s international headlines include Nvidia’s Q3 earnings, with the AI chip giant holding its earnings call as former CEO Jensen Huang steps down and the stock plummets, and the highly anticipated AI startup Anthropic finally going public. These two events will test whether AI‑driven trading can sustain its momentum. In addition, U.S. President Donald Trump will hold a trilateral meeting on Thursday with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, marking the third face‑to‑face encounter between Trump and Xi this year.
This week’s trading notes (20261116–1120)

1. Nvidia’s First Earnings Without Jensen Huang
After Jensen Huang’s resignation, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) will hold its first earnings call on Tuesday (the 17th) after market close, chaired by interim CEO and former CFO Colette Kress.

Analysts expect Q3 revenue to grow about 90% year‑over‑year to $109 billion, with EPS around $2.46. While the market believes the results will still be impressive, investors are focused on the leadership vacuum after Huang’s departure, any changes to growth forecasts, and whether AI financing commitments will continue.

Analysts are also curious whether Nvidia’s management will launch a large share‑repurchase program to support the stock; the company still has a $235 billion buyback authorization as of the end of September.

Nvidia’s share price fell 13% last week, marking a sixth consecutive week of losses—the longest streak since 2012—and its market cap slipped below $4 trillion on Friday’s close. Experts warn that, given the current uncertainty surrounding Nvidia, any earnings miss could amplify market penalties.

Nvidia is often called the “AI central bank,” providing massive financing to customers for expansion, with funds flowing back to Nvidia through chip purchases in a “circular financing” model that has drawn attention. The Wall Street Journal reported that months ago Kress and Huang disagreed over the structure of this circular financing, raising questions about whether Nvidia will continue to drive chip sales with large‑scale financing in the future.

Experts say the earnings call will test more than just quarterly numbers; after Huang’s exit, Kress must convince investors that Nvidia can maintain execution, financial discipline, and customer relationships while advancing its AI product roadmap during the leadership transition.

2. Anthropic IPO
Anthropic (ANT‑US) is slated to set its IPO price on Wednesday (the 18th) at $70‑$78 per share, then begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker “ANT” on Thursday. The company and certain investors plan to sell 825 million shares, raising up to $64.4 billion and valuing the firm at as much as $1.4 trillion.

Before Anthropic, Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX‑US) went public in June with a near‑$1.75 trillion valuation, raising $75 billion. After listing, SpaceX’s stock has been volatile, currently trading only slightly above its $135 IPO price and dipping to about $105 in August.

Madison Investments chief investment strategist Patrick Ryan warned that a weak post‑IPO performance by Anthropic could send another warning signal, highlighting growing pressure on investors in AI‑driven trading.

Jack Selby, managing partner of the Thiel family office, also cautioned that if this highly anticipated large AI IPO is priced far below market expectations or underperforms after debut, it could exacerbate a correction in AI stocks.

It is noteworthy that Nvidia intended to participate in a private placement alongside Anthropic’s IPO, committing roughly $10 billion; with Huang’s departure, investors are closely watching whether that commitment will be affected.

3. Trump‑Xi‑Putin Trilateral Meeting
The White House has confirmed that U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin will hold a three‑way meeting on Thursday (the 19th) on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen. This will be the third face‑to‑face encounter between Trump and Xi this year.

Trump plans to discuss the war in Iran with Xi and Putin but will avoid the Ukraine issue. A White House official said the talks aim to launch a nuclear‑arms‑reduction dialogue, describing it as “the start of a conversation we hope will yield results,” though no agreements are expected. Analysts note that expectations for concrete outcomes are low, with symbolic significance outweighing substance.
Additionally, with Democrats winning the U.S. midterms, China may gain leverage in trade talks, and Democrats could pressure Trump to unfreeze arms sales to Taiwan.

Regarding former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair scandal, a White House official said the matter should not affect the U.S.–China chip discussion; the U.S. will not tie export‑control enforcement to foreign negotiations, and Trump does not intend to question Xi about it.
White House officials also disclosed that Elon Musk, CEO of Tesla (TSLA‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US), will accompany Trump to Shenzhen for the APEC summit.

4. Fed Meeting Minutes and Kevin Warsh Chairs AI Working Group
The Federal Reserve will release the October meeting minutes on Wednesday. The Fed held rates steady at that meeting, but several officials have recently voiced hawkish concerns about rising inflation, and October CPI data showed accelerating price pressures, prompting the market to price in a higher likelihood of a December rate hike and even consider a possible January hike next year.

If the Fed does raise rates in both December and January, it would be the first consecutive hikes since 2023. Investors originally expected hikes in December and March 2025, but since last week have begun pricing in one‑point moves in December, January and March.

Several Fed officials will speak this week, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who has not spoken publicly since the post‑meeting press conference in October, is scheduled to chair a meeting of the AI‑and‑productivity working group on Monday. Market participants do not expect him to deviate from his previously stated stance of offering no forward guidance on monetary policy direction.

5. Oil Price Trends
Shifts in Middle‑East diplomatic dynamics, combined with cooling U.S. demand, are pushing international oil prices lower, though the decline is uneven.

Oil prices fell double‑digit percentages last week, reaching about $90 per barrel—a two‑month low—as many northern‑hemisphere regions brace for winter. The drop could help ease inflation pressures on policymakers and households.

However, recent attacks by Iran‑backed Houthi rebels on Saudi infrastructure, frequent assaults on oil tankers transporting crude from the Gulf, and ongoing supply disruptions affecting Russia have reminded markets that any new supply shock could quickly reignite upward pressure on oil prices.

items.title: 矽谷科技巨頭押注川普恐踢鐵板！OpenAI、Meta政治豪賭埋下AI產業隱憂
paras: 矽谷科技巨頭長期以擅長預測未來、掌握科技趨勢自居，但在美國政治局勢變化之際，OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）、SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克等科技領袖卻選擇公開支持美國總統川普的政策議程。隨著期中選舉結果改變政治版圖，這項押注不僅可能讓科技業面臨更大的政治風險，也讓外界開始質疑，這些自詡具有遠見的企業領袖，是否高估了自己的政治判斷力。
《MIT Technology Review》指出，科技業領袖在距離期中選舉僅剩5周時，仍聚集白宮與川普合影，並支持他的「超級智慧」（Super Intelligence）議程。
然而，當時已有數十項民調顯示，反川普情緒持續升高，且兩黨選民對人工智慧（AI）及資料中心的反對聲浪也逐漸擴大，科技巨頭卻為了爭取短期政治利益，將企業長期發展押在川普政府身上。
分析指出，這項決策如今可能帶來反效果。科技業不僅可能成為新政治局勢下的攻防目標，企業領導人的政治立場也可能成為難以擺脫的包袱。

科技業員工也不解 高層選舉後反應低調

科技業內部對高層的政治押注同樣感到困惑。曾與OpenAI、Meta(META-US) 等企業員工交流的評論者指出，選舉結果出爐後，部分科技公司高層至今沒有公開說明後續方向。
Meta執行長祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）尚未在公司內部談論選舉結果，另一家AI企業員工也表示，管理層在Slack上的發言相當有限。
員工普遍擔心，民主黨重新掌握華府政治主導權後，可能推動限制資料中心的立法，也關注企業高層將如何調整策略。不過，比起政策變化，更令部分員工不解的是，為何企業領導人沒有提前察覺政治風向可能轉變。
矽谷管理文化向來推崇冰球傳奇球星葛瑞茲基（Wayne Gretzky）的名言：「滑向冰球即將到達的位置，而不是它現在所在的位置。」這套思維強調預測趨勢、提前布局，而非被動回應眼前局勢。
科技新創也經常透過轉型調整商業模式，無法跟上時代的企業往往遭到市場淘汰。然而，評論指出，祖克柏、OpenAI共同創辦人布羅克曼（Greg Brockman），以及其他AI產業領袖和創投業者，這次卻選擇將自身與川普的政治、文化及商業議程緊密綁定，陷入可能難以脫身的政治困境。

科技巨頭放棄跨黨派布局 長期投資恐成政治攻防目標

評論表示，這場風波反映出科技業領袖並非如外界想像般無所不知。即使在社群媒體或AI領域具有深厚專業，也不代表他們同樣擅長判斷政治、經濟或其他領域的發展。
白宮接觸機會、政府補貼，以及參與自身產業監管的機會，可能讓科技業高層過度重視眼前利益，忽略美國政治權力更迭的基本規律。
相較之下，摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 、波音(BA-US) 等大型企業，通常不會將自身公開綁定特定政治陣營。這是企業長期經營累積的經驗：美國政府每4年可能更替，但企業合約及大型投資計畫往往長達10年，商業布局必須超越單一政府任期。
因此，多數企業會盡可能維持與兩黨的關係，避免政策變動直接衝擊商業模式。然而，科技巨頭這次選擇押注川普，卻可能讓旗下最重要的發展計畫，尤其是涉及電網接入及資料中心許可的大型投資，成為民主黨的優先監督與政治攻防對象。
此外，企業政治形象一旦受損，也不像軟體功能或程式碼能夠隨時修改。評論以Palantir(PLTR-US) 執行長卡普（Alex Karp）為例，指出他過去一年不斷發表強硬言論，並向投資人強調公司「完全反覺醒」，未來是否還能突然轉向進步派立場，恐怕難以取信於外界。
一名曾與祖克柏密切共事的Meta員工也形容，祖克柏雖然擅長長期思考，卻未必有明確的實現路徑，決策方式更像是廣泛嘗試、寄望成功，再觀察後續發展。該員工並指出，Facebook過去也很少針對重大策略失誤進行完整檢討。

AI競賽政治化 損害產業爭取基礎建設的籌碼

評論認為，科技業這次最大的失誤，是將AI產業發展捲入美國文化及政治戰線。過去光纖技術與無線通訊基礎建設等重大科技發展，並未成為明顯的黨派政治議題，但矽谷對川普政府的靠攏，卻讓AI逐漸成為文化戰爭的一部分。
如今，從加州到佛羅里達州，民眾在表決資料中心建設提案時，考量的已不只是技術或經濟效益，還包括企業與政治陣營的關係。
分析指出，對急於在AI競賽中取得領先地位的科技巨頭而言，這種政治風險尤其值得警惕。企業領袖過度聚焦AI競爭的迫切性，卻低估公眾信任與企業聲譽受損後，可能對產業發展造成的衝擊。
資料中心、電力供應及相關基礎建設，都是AI產業持續擴張的重要條件，而這些投資同樣需要地方政府與民眾支持。當科技企業失去原本的社會信任，即使掌握領先技術，也可能難以取得推動產業發展所需的資源與許可。
這場政治押注已經動搖矽谷長期以來的一項核心形象：科技領袖總能比其他人更早看見未來。

items.title: 伊朗利用美國士兵跑步App蒐集情報 炸出90億美元損失
items.title_en: Iran Used U.S. Soldiers' Running App to Gather Intelligence, Causing $9 Billion in Losses
paras: 美軍擁有全球最先進的衛星、雷達和情報系統，卻可能被士兵手機裡的跑步軟體出賣。
美國《洛杉磯時報》14日（周六）發表調查，指出在今年爆發的美伊戰爭中，伊朗通過蒐集美軍人員的社交媒體、健身App和商業廣告數據，結合據稱來自俄羅斯的衛星圖像，分析美軍基地人員活動規律，為飛彈和無人機襲擊提供情報支援。
這場情報戰的後果相當嚴重。
根據《美聯社》10月31日公布的衛星圖像調查，截至今年8月，伊朗及其支持的武裝在中東26處美軍基地和相關設施發動的襲擊中，至少有115次造成建築或設施損壞。遭襲目標包括雷達、機場跑道、機庫、通訊設備和人員營房。
《洛杉磯時報》援引的估算顯示，僅修復這些基地的基礎設施就可能耗資約90億美元，尚不包括飛機、先進雷達等軍事裝備的損失。
一款跑步軟體，如何暴露軍事祕密？
伊朗獲取情報的方式，可能比傳統間諜活動簡單得多。
今年8月，英國《Sky News》的調查發現，超過1,300名Strava健身App用戶在中東美軍基地分享運動紀錄，涉及數千次跑步、騎行等活動。
這些紀錄不僅包含運動路線，還包括具體時間，甚至能夠反映軍事人員的日常活動、部隊調動和撤離情況。
令人驚訝的是，美軍早在2018年就已警告，這類App可能暴露軍事行動，但八年之後，類似問題仍然存在。
洩密渠道甚至不限於軍人自己發布的內容。
在巴林的美國海軍支援基地，Google地圖上的公開訊息能夠顯示保齡球館、健身房、餐廳等設施的位置，用戶評論中甚至包含健身房開放時間。
對軍事情報人員而言，長期積累的這些零散訊息，可以幫助判斷基地內部不同區域的用途及人員活動規律。
paras_en: The U.S. military possesses the world’s most advanced satellites, radars and intelligence systems, yet it may be betrayed by a running app on soldiers’ phones.

The Los Angeles Times published an investigation on Saturday, the 14th, indicating that in the Iran‑U.S. war that erupted this year, Iran collected U.S. service members’ social‑media, fitness‑app and commercial‑advertising data, combined with satellite imagery allegedly from Russia, to analyze patterns of activity at U.S. bases and provide intelligence support for missile and drone attacks.
The consequences of this intelligence battle are severe.

According to a satellite‑imagery investigation released by the Associated Press on Oct. 31, attacks by Iran and its proxy forces on 26 U.S. bases and related facilities in the Middle East through August this year resulted in at least 115 incidents that damaged buildings or infrastructure. Targets hit included radars, airfield runways, hangars, communications gear and personnel barracks.

The Los Angeles Times cited estimates that merely repairing the infrastructure at these bases could cost roughly $9 billion, not counting losses of aircraft, advanced radars and other military equipment.
How can a running app expose military secrets?
Iran’s method of obtaining intelligence may be far simpler than traditional espionage.

In August, a Sky News investigation found that more than 1,300 Strava fitness‑app users posted workout records from U.S. bases in the Middle East, covering thousands of runs, rides and other activities.
These records include not only the routes but also precise timestamps, which can reveal daily routines of military personnel, unit movements and evacuations.
Surprisingly, the U.S. military warned as early as 2018 that such apps could expose operations, yet the problem persists eight years later.
The leak channels are not limited to content posted by service members themselves.

At a U.S. Navy support base in Bahrain, publicly available information on Google Maps shows the locations of bowling alleys, gyms, restaurants and other facilities, with user reviews even listing gym opening hours.
For intelligence analysts, the long‑term accumulation of these scattered bits of data can help determine the functions of different areas within a base and the patterns of personnel activity.

items.title: OpenAI測試ChatGPT商家功能！導入AI導購代理  商家可上架商品、掌握推薦流量
items.title_en: OpenAI Tests ChatGPT Merchant Feature! Introducing AI Shopping Agent; Merchants Can List Products and Track Recommendation Traffic
paras: 生成式人工智慧（AI）競爭延伸至電商領域。OpenAI近日宣布，開始測試ChatGPT商家功能，讓通過驗證的美國商家認領品牌頁面、提交商品價格與庫存目錄，並導入商家AI代理，直接在ChatGPT內回答消費者的商品問題，將AI對話轉化為購物入口。
這項測試也提供品牌導購與商家代理功能。商家可在後台更新商品資訊，讓AI代理掌握產品內容，依據消費者需求提供回答；消費者則能從ChatGPT的商品推薦進入商家頁面，與品牌專屬AI代理展開獨立對話，進一步詢問產品功效。
當消費者決定購買時，AI會提供商家官方網站連結，引導消費者完成交易。
商家也能透過後台查看過去28天內被ChatGPT提及的次數及商品點擊量等數據，掌握品牌在AI對話中的曝光情況。
這並非ChatGPT首次涉足電商交易。去年9月，美國用戶已可透過ChatGPT對話直接購買Etsy(ETSY-US) 商品；此次推出的商家測試，則進一步讓品牌能管理自己的商品資訊，並透過AI代理與潛在買家互動。
AI逐漸成為消費者搜尋商品與評估購買選項的管道。Adobe(ADBE-US) 今年9月針對美國零售網站的數據顯示，來自AI工具的網站點擊量年增71%；而在已進入零售網站的訪客中，AI來源流量的購買轉換率比非AI來源高出90%。
大型零售與科技業者也陸續布局AI購物服務。美妝零售商 Sephora 今年3月已在ChatGPT推出品牌應用程式，讓消費者透過對話取得符合自身膚質的化妝品推薦；若連結會員帳號，系統還能參考個人偏好提供商品建議。
沃爾瑪(WMT-US) 則更早將購物服務整合至ChatGPT，讓消費者能直接在對話中選購商品，並使用沃爾瑪會員權益與支付方式。
沃爾瑪曾指出，零售服務正從被動回應轉向主動提供協助，業者需要運用AI掌握消費者需求，在顧客提出問題前就提供適當推薦。
除了ChatGPT，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 與Google(GOOGL-US) 也在擴大AI購物功能。亞馬遜近期邀請部分美國用戶測試Alexa簡訊購物服務，未來幾周計畫向數百萬用戶開放。消費者可傳送食譜照片，讓Alexa辨識所需食材並加入購物車，也能依照指示直接下單。
Google則已開始在加拿大推出直接結帳功能。消費者透過搜尋引擎的AI模式或Gemini比較商品時，符合條件的商品可直接進行結帳。
隨著消費者逐漸習慣在購物前先向AI詢問商品資訊，AI平台也開始從資訊搜尋延伸至商品推薦與交易環節。對商家而言，ChatGPT等工具不只是新的導購服務，也可能成為接觸潛在客戶的流量入口。
當消費者透過AI比較商品時，能否進入最初的推薦清單，可能影響後續取得訂單的機會。隨著電商與AI服務持續整合，商家如何管理商品資料、提高在AI推薦中的能見度，也將成為新的競爭課題。
paras_en: Generative AI competition is extending into e‑commerce. OpenAI announced it is now testing a ChatGPT merchant feature that lets verified U.S. merchants claim brand pages, submit product price and inventory catalogs, and deploy a merchant AI agent to answer consumer product questions directly within ChatGPT, turning AI dialogue into a shopping gateway.

The test also provides brand‑shopping and merchant‑agent capabilities. Merchants can update product information in a backend so the AI agent knows the product details and can answer based on consumer needs; consumers can follow product recommendations from ChatGPT to a merchant page and start a separate conversation with the brand‑specific AI agent to ask about product benefits.
When a consumer decides to buy, the AI supplies a link to the merchant’s official website, guiding the consumer to complete the transaction.
Merchants can also view data in the backend showing how many times their brand was mentioned by ChatGPT and product click‑throughs over the past 28 days, giving insight into AI‑driven exposure.

This is not ChatGPT’s first foray into e‑commerce. In September last year, U.S. users could already purchase Etsy (ETSY‑US) items through a ChatGPT conversation; the new merchant test further lets brands manage their own product information and interact with potential buyers via an AI agent.

AI is increasingly becoming a channel for consumers to search for products and evaluate purchase options. Adobe (ADBE‑US) reported in September that AI‑driven website clicks for U.S. retail sites grew 71% year‑over‑year, and among visitors who reached retail sites, the purchase conversion rate from AI traffic was 90% higher than non‑AI traffic.

Large retailers and tech firms are also rolling out AI shopping services. Beauty retailer Sephora launched a brand app on ChatGPT in March, allowing consumers to get makeup recommendations suited to their skin type through conversation; linking a loyalty account lets the system also factor personal preferences into product suggestions.
Walmart (WMT‑US) integrated shopping services into ChatGPT even earlier, enabling consumers to select and purchase items directly in the chat and use Walmart membership benefits and payment methods.

Walmart has said retail services are shifting from passive response to proactive assistance, and operators need to use AI to anticipate consumer needs and provide appropriate recommendations before a question is asked.

Beyond ChatGPT, Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Google (GOOGL‑US) are expanding AI shopping features. Amazon recently invited a subset of U.S. users to test an Alexa text‑shopping service and plans to roll it out to millions in the coming weeks; users can send a recipe photo, have Alexa identify needed ingredients, add them to a cart, and place orders by voice.
Google has begun rolling out a direct checkout feature in Canada. When consumers compare products via the search engine’s AI mode or Gemini, qualifying items can be checked out directly.

As consumers grow accustomed to asking AI for product information before buying, AI platforms are moving from information search to recommendation and transaction stages. For merchants, tools like ChatGPT are not just new referral services but could become traffic entry points to reach potential customers.

When consumers compare products through AI, whether a brand appears in the initial recommendation list can affect its chances of securing orders. As e‑commerce and AI services continue to merge, how merchants manage product data and boost visibility in AI recommendations will become a fresh competitive challenge.

items.title: 誰能駕馭這頭巨獸？哈佛教授：黃仁勳辭職後  輝達面臨「20年最難接班」問題
items.title_en: Who Can Tame This Beast? Harvard Professor Says Nvidia Faces Its Most Difficult Succession in 20 Years After Jensen Huang’s Resignation
paras: 輝達創辦人黃仁勳上周突宣布辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效，結束其長達33年的掌舵生涯。這位長期自詡「無可替代」的創辦人離去，令這家全球最具價值的AI晶片巨頭瞬間陷入接班真空。
黃仁勳歷來採取高度集權的扁平化管理，擁有約60名直屬部屬，決策權高度集中於一身；英偉達董事會過去甚至未設董事長職位，無人能制衡其決定。
黃仁勳親自建立並維繫公司最重要的外部人脈，從拉攏美國總統川普，到與台積電創辦人張忠謀維持密切關係，為輝達取得稀缺產能優先權。
憑藉個人直覺，黃仁勳帶領公司在AI等領域做出大膽早期押注，將輝達打造成全球最具價值企業之一。
據悉，黃仁勳雖保持低調，但仍參與繼任過程，並已與至少一名潛在候選人通話。
然而，尋找繼任者難度極高。哈佛商學院教授Andy Wu直言，這是「至少10到20年來最難填補的執行長職位」。他指出，AI投資本質上要求承擔風險，這類看似非理性的押注，需要一位具備創辦人同等掌控力與感召力的領導者，才能在投資者面前保持靈活溝通，並激勵員工執行外界眼中「近乎荒謬」的遠景。
目前，輝達財務長柯蕾絲(Colette Kress)已出任臨時執行長，董事會同步啟動正式執行長遴選，內外部人選均納入考量。這家與黃仁勳個人願景、魅力深度交織的企業，正式邁入未知的「後黃仁勳時代」。
paras_en: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang abruptly announced last week that he is stepping down from his roles as president, chief executive officer and director, effective immediately, ending a 33‑year reign. The long‑time self‑described “irreplaceable” founder’s departure leaves the world’s most valuable AI‑chip giant suddenly facing a leadership vacuum.

Huang has always run a highly centralized, flat organization, with about 60 direct reports and decision‑making power concentrated in his hands; Nvidia’s board historically did not even have a chairman, leaving no one to check his decisions.

Huang personally built and maintained the company’s most important external relationships, from courting former U.S. President Donald Trump to keeping close ties with TSMC founder Morris Chang, securing priority access to scarce manufacturing capacity for Nvidia.
Relying on his own intuition, Huang led the company to make bold early bets in AI and other fields, turning Nvidia into one of the world’s most valuable enterprises.
Sources say that although Huang is keeping a low profile, he is still involved in the succession process and has already spoken with at least one potential candidate.

Finding a successor, however, is extremely difficult. Harvard Business School professor Andy Wu bluntly called it “the hardest CEO role to fill in at least the past 10 to 20 years.” He noted that AI investment inherently involves risk and that such seemingly irrational bets require a leader with founder‑level control and charisma to communicate flexibly with investors and inspire employees to pursue visions that outsiders might deem almost absurd.

For now, Nvidia’s chief financial officer Colette Kress has stepped in as interim CEO, and the board has launched a formal search for a permanent chief executive, considering both internal and external candidates. The company, whose identity is deeply intertwined with Huang’s personal vision and charisma, is now officially entering an unknown “post‑Huang” era.

items.title: 黃仁勳辭任獲矽谷大咖聲援！馬斯克、Gavin Baker、Epic Games執行長批輝達董事會
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Resigns, Receives Backing from Silicon Valley Heavyweights: Musk, Gavin Baker, and Epic Games CEO Criticize Nvidia Board
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳辭職後，矽谷多名企業領袖與投資人接連公開表態支持，認為黃仁勳是公司難以取代的核心人物，若他離開，恐動搖輝達與人工智慧（AI）產業之間的合作關係，甚至影響美國在AI競賽中的地位。
根據《紐約時報》報導，黃仁勳上周四（12日）辭去輝達執行長職務，此前傳出他與一名公司員工及一名中國女性有染。消息曝光後，多名科技業高層、投資人及新創企業領袖透過社群平台發文或致函董事會，要求重新考慮黃仁勳的去留，並質疑董事會是否迫於外界壓力做出決定。
SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長、全球首富馬斯克周六（14日）在社群平台表示，黃仁勳在輝達供應鏈管理方面表現出色，許多交易仰賴雙方握手達成，而非正式書面合約。
他直言，少了黃仁勳，至少部分關鍵交易可能無法延續。
Altimeter Capital Management執行長Brad Gerstner與Atreides Management首席投資長Gavin Baker周五（13日）亦致函輝達董事會，指出倉促更換黃仁勳並不符合股東最大利益，要求董事會考慮所有可能選項，包括讓黃仁勳重新出任執行長。
另一封名為《與黃仁勳站在一起》的公開信，則直接要求輝達董事會重新任命黃仁勳為執行長、展開獨立調查，並對相關事件作出說明。
截至周六（14日）上午，該信已獲得近10萬人簽署，支持者包括輝達現任與前任員工、馬斯克等商業夥伴，以及創投公司Y Combinator執行長Garry Tan等新創業界人士與股東。
這波聲援也凸顯黃仁勳在AI產業中的影響力。輝達從早期生產電玩用晶片起家，如今已掌握美國大型AI計畫所使用的先進晶片市場90%。隨著公司成長為全球市值最高的企業之一，黃仁勳也成為矽谷重要的交易推手，協助需要晶片與資金的新創企業建立合作關係。
部分企業領袖對輝達董事會的批評更為直接。通訊應用程式Telegram執行長杜羅夫（Pavel Durov）周五在社群平台發文，認為黃仁勳犯下新手錯誤，並藉此提醒創辦人應掌握董事會主導權。
電玩公司Epic Games執行長史威尼（Tim Sweeney）周四則批評輝達董事會存在嚴重的公司治理問題。他在黃仁勳辭職前一天曾表示，如果董事會撤換黃仁勳，將是如同蘋果(AAPL-US) 當年解雇賈伯斯般愚蠢的決定。
1985年，蘋果董事會曾罷免共同創辦人賈伯斯（Steve Jobs），直到1997年他才重返公司，再度出任執行長。
創投家Elad Gil也在周四發文指出，黃仁勳辭職為所有創辦人敲響警鐘，應重新檢視董事會成員組成。他建議創辦人應趁公司順利時調整董事會，以免在情勢不利時遭遇突如其來的變動。
Uber (UBER-US) 共同創辦人、前執行長卡蘭尼克（Travis Kalanick）的經歷，也成為外界討論的案例。2017年，優步面臨日益嚴重的法律與道德爭議，公司最大投資人要求卡蘭尼克辭職；他離開執行長職位後，便未再回到優步。
paras_en: After Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, numerous Silicon Valley business leaders and investors publicly voiced support, saying Huang is an irreplaceable core figure for the company and that his departure could jeopardize Nvidia's collaborations with the artificial intelligence (AI) industry and even affect the United States' standing in the AI race.

According to the New York Times, Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO last Thursday (the 12th) following rumors of an affair with a company employee and a Chinese woman. After the story broke, many tech executives, investors and startup leaders posted on social media or wrote letters to the board urging a reconsideration of Huang's exit and questioning whether the board yielded to external pressure.

SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO and world’s richest man Elon Musk posted on social media on Saturday (the 14th) that Huang excelled at managing Nvidia’s supply chain, noting that many deals rely on a handshake between the parties rather than formal written contracts.
He stated plainly that without Huang, at least some key transactions might not be able to continue.

Altimeter Capital Management CEO Brad Gerstner and Atreides Management chief investment officer Gavin Baker also wrote to Nvidia’s board on Friday (the 13th), arguing that a rushed replacement of Huang does not serve shareholders’ best interests and urging the board to consider all options, including reinstating Huang as CEO.
Another open letter titled “Standing with Jensen Huang” directly called on Nvidia’s board to re‑appoint Huang as CEO, launch an independent investigation, and provide an explanation of the incident.

By Saturday morning (the 14th), the letter had been signed by nearly 100,000 people, including current and former Nvidia employees, business partners such as Musk, and startup community figures and shareholders like Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan.

The wave of support also highlights Huang’s influence in the AI sector. Nvidia, which began by making chips for video games, now controls about 90% of the advanced chip market used in large U.S. AI projects. As the company has grown into one of the world’s most valuable firms, Huang has become a key deal‑maker in Silicon Valley, helping chip‑ and capital‑hungry startups forge partnerships.

Some business leaders were more blunt in their criticism of Nvidia’s board. Telegram founder Pavel Durov posted on social media on Friday, saying Huang made a rookie mistake and using the episode to remind founders to retain control over their boards.

Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney criticized Nvidia’s board on Thursday, saying it suffers from serious corporate‑governance problems. He had warned the day before Huang’s resignation that removing him would be as foolish as Apple (AAPL-US) firing Steve Jobs.
In 1985 Apple’s board ousted co‑founder Steve Jobs, who did not return to the company until 1997, when he was reinstated as CEO.

Venture capitalist Elad Gil also posted on Thursday that Huang’s resignation should sound an alarm for all founders, urging a review of board composition. He suggested founders adjust their boards while the company is thriving to avoid sudden upheavals when conditions turn adverse.

The experience of Uber (UBER-US) co‑founder and former CEO Travis Kalanick is also being cited. In 2017 Uber faced mounting legal and ethical controversies, and its largest investor demanded Kalanick’s resignation; after stepping down as CEO he never returned to the company.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元創9月來最大單週漲幅 Fed升息幾成定局
items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Posts Biggest Weekly Gain Since September as Fed Rate Hikes Near Certain
paras: 美元周五(13日)再創19個月新高，並寫下9月中旬以來最強單週表現。這波漲勢主要受到市場對美國聯準會(Fed)升息預期大幅升高所帶動。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報103.41，創2025年4月2日以來新高。本週已上漲1.1%。
美元這波漲勢始於上週五美國就業報告公布後。美國10月非農就業人數增加16.5萬人，遠高於市場預期的6.5萬人。此外，8月與9月的就業人數合計上修8.4萬人。
美元週一短暫喘息後，週二再度走高，主要因美國消費者物價指數(CPI)數據高於預期。10月整體CPI月增0.4%，低於9月的0.6%，但仍高於市場預期的0.3%。排除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心CPI月增率維持在0.3%，略高於市場預期的0.2%。
數據顯示，美國勞動市場表現強勁，通膨也持續居高不下。在此情況下，央行通常會採取緊縮貨幣政策。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)週二進一步釋出鷹派訊號，表示即使通膨數據低於預期，他仍支持升息，他並指出，若數據再度偏熱，政策利率甚至可能需要一次調升50個基點，高於一般升息幅度。
週五公布的最新生產者物價指數(PPI)報告，則稍稍緩解市場疑慮。10月整體PPI月增0.3%，明顯低於9月的1.4%，也低於市場預期的0.4%。年增率則為6.5%，略低於預期的6.6%。不過，這仍是2022年11月以來最大的12個月漲幅。

paras_en: The dollar hit a 19‑month high on Friday (the 13th) and recorded its strongest weekly performance since mid‑September. This rally was driven mainly by a sharp rise in market expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 103.41, a peak not seen since April 2, 2025. It is up 1.1% for the week.

The dollar’s advance began after Friday’s U.S. jobs report. Non‑farm payrolls for October increased by 165,000, far above the 65,000 forecast, and the August‑September combined payroll figure was revised up by 84,000.

After a brief pause on Monday, the dollar moved higher again on Tuesday, largely because U.S. consumer price index (CPI) data came in hotter than expected. October’s overall CPI rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, down from September’s 0.6% but still above the 0.3% market estimate. Core CPI, which strips out volatile food and energy prices, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, slightly above the 0.2% forecast.

The data show a still‑robust labor market and persistently high inflation, conditions that typically prompt central banks to tighten policy. Fed Governor Christopher Waller signaled further hawkishness on Tuesday, saying that even if inflation data miss expectations he still backs a rate hike and noted that a repeat of hot data could warrant a 50‑basis‑point move, larger than the usual increment.

The latest producer price index (PPI) released on Friday eased some concerns. October’s overall PPI rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, well below September’s 1.4% and the 0.4% market forecast. The year‑over‑year rate was 6.5%, just under the 6.6% expected, but it remains the biggest 12‑month gain since November 2022.

Chris Osmond, Chief Investment Officer at Fifth Third Wealth Advisors, said, “The good news is that producer‑price inflation has cooled from its September peak. The bad news is that the decline may not be enough for the market to see the rate‑cut relief it hopes for. Producer‑price inflation is still at a 6.5% annual pace, and today’s report raises the risk that restrictive rates will have to stay in place longer than investors originally expected.”

He added, “Perhaps more important than the headline number is that inflation pressure is spreading from energy to other areas. Energy prices fell in October, but food rose 1.3%, services posted a fifth consecutive month of price gains, and transportation and warehousing costs rose 2.0%. This shows inflation is seeping into the broader economy rather than staying confined to the initial price‑pressure zones. If this continues, it will be harder for the Fed to treat inflation as a temporary phenomenon.”

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders are almost certain the Fed will raise rates in December, with the question being the size of the hike. The market assigns roughly a 90% probability to a 25‑basis‑point increase and about a 10% chance of a 50‑basis‑point move.
The yen slipped past the 160 per dollar barrier again.

A stronger dollar put pressure on the yen, which posted its worst weekly performance since mid‑September. The yen was last quoted at 159.76 per dollar, after briefly touching a low of 160.19 earlier in the session.

This marks the second consecutive trading day the yen fell below the 160 level. It first breached that threshold on Thursday, the first time since September 2. Historically, the 160 barrier has often triggered large‑scale intervention by Tokyo authorities.

Japan’s Ministry of Finance said on Monday that between July and September it intervened in the foreign‑exchange market for a total of ¥15.4 trillion (about $96.38 billion), including a record ¥7.98 trillion on July 30 and ¥5.55 trillion on July 31 when it coordinated an unprecedented joint action with Washington. This is the first time since 1998 that the U.S. and Japan have jointly bought yen.

Atsushi Mimura, the senior official in charge of foreign‑exchange affairs at the Ministry, warned the market to beware of “unilateral moves” and told traders that it was “still too early to say the joint U.S.–Japan intervention is over.”
A stronger dollar also weighed on the euro. The euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1022, marking its weakest weekly performance since early October.

Preliminary official estimates released earlier showed Euro‑area GDP grew 0.4% quarter‑on‑quarter in Q3 2026, down from 0.6% in Q2 but in line with expectations. The data also revised labor‑market conditions, indicating that employment growth stalled in the third quarter.

paras: 日元兌美元匯率再度逼近160這個日本當局曾出手干預的重要關卡之際，日本最高外匯事務官員三村淳(Atsushi Mimura)周四(12日)警告市場參與者，「現在還不是忘記今年夏季干預行動的時候」，顯示日本當局已準備好再次出手干預，以支撐日元。
日本財務省主管匯率事務的最高官員三村淳說：「我強烈感覺到，過去幾天的匯率波動速度太快了。」他並表示：「現在還不是忘記今年夏天發生什麼事的時候。」不過，他沒有針對特定匯率水準發表評論。
這是三村淳自9月底以來首度針對外匯市場發表談話，而他所指的是日本7月底至8月初買進日元的干預行動，包括與美國聯手進場的操作。
三村淳發出警告之際，日元兌美元匯率周四盤中一度升至159.94，創逾兩個月來新高。日元先前貶破160關卡之後，日本當局7月曾連續三天進場支撐日元，其中一部分還是與美國協調進行的。夏季那波為期三天的干預行動協助日元兌美元匯率從貶破163，回升至最高155.23。
在聯手干預行動後，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與日本財務大臣片山皋月曾警告，當局已準備好再次採取行動，以因應匯市波動。

日元走弱推升進口成本 日本通膨壓力升高

日元疲軟一直是日本決策官員面臨的棘手問題，這導致進口成本大幅攀升。周四公布的數據顯示，以日元計價的進口物價指數10月年增24.8%。
美國通膨數據偏熱，加上聯準會(Fed)官員發表鷹派談話，讓市場愈來愈預期美國將升息，帶動美元走強。而在市場預期美日利差將進一步擴大的情況下，日元再度蒙受壓力。
日本方面，市場已大致消化日本銀行(BOJ，央行)將在12月18日至19日會議升息的預期。但後續升息時程仍不明朗，因為市場預期日本政策利率將逐步接近中性利率水準。
瑞穗證券分析師說：「美國經濟展現韌性，加上人工智慧(AI)投資強勁帶動通膨持續處於高檔，美元兌日元匯率可能繼續走高。」
報告指出：「如果美元突破160關卡，且日元進一步走弱推升通膨，增加首相高市早苗政府支持度下滑的風險，東京當局可能採取單方面干預行動。」
paras_en: The yen‑dollar exchange rate is once again approaching the critical 160 level where Japanese authorities have previously intervened, and Japan's top foreign exchange official Atsushi Mimura warned market participants on Thursday (the 12th) that "now is not the time to forget this summer's intervention action," indicating that the authorities are ready to step in again to support the yen.

Atsushi Mimura, the senior official in charge of exchange rate matters at the Ministry of Finance, said, "I strongly feel that the speed of exchange‑rate fluctuations over the past few days has been too rapid," adding, "Now is not the time to forget what happened this summer." He did not comment on any specific exchange‑rate level.

This is Mimura's first public comment on the foreign‑exchange market since the end of September, referring to Japan's July‑late to early‑August intervention that bought yen, including coordinated actions with the United States.

When Mimura issued his warning, the yen‑dollar rate rose intraday on Thursday to 159.94, a two‑month high. After the yen slipped past the 160 barrier, Japanese authorities intervened for three consecutive days in July, part of which was coordinated with the U.S.; that three‑day summer intervention helped lift the yen from a dip below 163 back up to a peak of 155.23.

Following the joint intervention, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki warned that the authorities were prepared to act again in response to market volatility.

A weak yen has been a persistent headache for Japanese policymakers, driving up import costs. Data released on Thursday showed the import price index, measured in yen, rose 24.8% year‑on‑year in October.

U.S. inflation data remains hot and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials have heightened expectations of further U.S. rate hikes, strengthening the dollar. With markets expecting the Japan‑U.S. interest‑rate gap to widen, the yen faces renewed pressure.

In Japan, markets have largely priced in expectations that the Bank of Japan will raise rates at its meeting on December 18‑19, but the timing of any further hikes remains unclear as markets anticipate the policy rate moving gradually toward a neutral level.
Mizuho Securities analysts said, "The U.S. economy is showing resilience, and strong AI‑driven investment is keeping inflation elevated, so the dollar‑yen pair may continue to rise."

The report noted, "If the dollar breaks the 160 barrier and the yen weakens further, pushing up inflation and increasing the risk of declining support for Prime Minister Kishida's government, Tokyo may resort to unilateral intervention."

他指出，無論是聯準會一次升息 50 個基點，或加快目前每季升息一次的緊縮步伐，如今都已成為市場實際討論的政策選項。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，周三貨幣市場預估，聯準會 12 月升息 25 個基點的機率達 88%，升息 50 個基點的機率則為 12%。
在周二通膨數據公布後，華爾街主要券商也陸續調整利率預測。
高盛目前預估，聯準會將分別在今年 12 月及明年 3 月升息；德意志銀行則預期，聯準會將在今年 12 月、明年 1 月及 3 月連續升息，顯示市場對貨幣政策進一步緊縮的預期正在升高。
美元還能漲多高？市場緊盯PPI數據
不過，在 12 月升息逐漸成為市場基本預期後，美元能否進一步突破高點，仍取決於後續經濟數據與聯準會政策訊號。
DHF Capital 資產經理 Bas Kooijman 表示，若美元要延續漲勢，市場可能需要進一步提高對聯準會升息 50 個基點的押注。
他指出，若周五公布的美國生產者物價指數（PPI）再度高於預期，或聯準會官員持續釋出鷹派訊號，可能進一步推升美債殖利率，帶動美元突破近期高點。
反之，若經濟數據轉弱，或投資人對大幅升息的預期降溫，美元可能回吐部分漲幅。
值得注意的是，美國公債市場周三因退伍軍人節假期休市。
歐元跌破1.11 法國債務問題再添壓力
美元強勢走高，也持續對其他主要貨幣形成壓力。
今年以來，除了澳元與挪威克朗之外，多數 G10 已開發市場貨幣兌美元均呈現貶值，反映美國與其他經濟體之間不斷擴大的利差。
部分分析師也認為，今年美元的強勢表現，部分來自美國與以色列對伊朗戰爭期間湧入的避險資金。
其中，歐元承受的壓力尤其明顯。
歐元兌美元隔夜下跌 0.65%，跌破 1.11 美元關卡，延續前一交易日跌勢，並觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最低水準。
除了美元走強，法國債務問題持續拖累歐元，加上近期油價回落，市場對歐洲央行升息的預期也有所降溫。
荷蘭合作銀行（Rabobank）外匯策略師 Jane Foley 指出，歐洲央行上次新聞發布會透露，管理委員會對經濟成長前景的擔憂日益加深。
她表示，另一項可能在未來數月壓抑歐元的因素，是明年法國總統大選帶來的政治不確定性。若極右派候選人當選總統，可能對歐盟未來合作方向產生影響。
荷蘭合作銀行預估，歐元兌美元將在未來三個月內進一步跌至 1.10。
隨著聯準會升息預期持續升溫，市場接下來將密切關注美國通膨數據與官員談話，判斷美元是否仍有進一步走強的空間。
paras_en: U.S. inflation continues to heat up, and Fed officials have been issuing hawkish signals, causing rate‑hike expectations to surge. The ICE Dollar Index rose to 102.96 on Wednesday (the 11th), hitting a 19‑month high.

As traders began betting that the Fed could raise rates by two full points in December, short‑term U.S. Treasury yields spiked, major currencies worldwide came under pressure, and the dollar’s rally became the market’s focal point.
With traders pricing in a two‑point Fed hike in December, Treasury yields climbed, major currencies were pressured, and the dollar took center stage in financial markets.
Market data show that the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the dollar against a basket of major currencies, reached a intraday high of 102.96 on Wednesday, the highest level since April 2025.

The Bloomberg Dollar Index, also closely watched by the market, posted its biggest two‑day gain since June this year, touching its highest level since May 2025. The dollar strengthened against almost all major currencies, indicating continued buying pressure.
The dollar’s current rally accelerated noticeably on Tuesday, driven by a combination of U.S. inflation data and hawkish comments from Fed officials.

The latest data show that October’s U.S. consumer price inflation rose above expectations for the third consecutive month, prompting traders to reassess the Fed’s future rate‑hike magnitude and even start pricing in a possible 50‑basis‑point (two‑point) hike in December.

As short‑term Treasury yields surged, the interest‑rate gap between the United States and other major economies widened, further attracting funds seeking higher returns into dollar‑denominated assets.
Probability of a one‑point December hike reaches 88% – Wall Street revises forecasts.
CIBC strategist Jeremy Stretch said the dollar’s recent strength is mainly due to the market’s ongoing recalibration of expectations for the Fed’s monetary‑policy path.
He noted that whether the Fed raises rates by 50 basis points in one move or accelerates its current quarterly‑rate‑hike cadence, both options are now being seriously discussed in the market.

According to London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) data, Wednesday’s currency‑market estimates put the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December at 88%, while a 50‑basis‑point hike was seen at 12%.
After Tuesday’s inflation data release, major Wall Street brokerages began adjusting their rate forecasts.

Goldman Sachs now expects the Fed to raise rates in both December this year and March next year; Deutsche Bank forecasts three consecutive hikes in December, January and March, indicating rising market expectations for further monetary tightening.
How much higher can the dollar go? Markets keep a close eye on PPI data.
However, once a December hike becomes the market’s baseline expectation, whether the dollar can push beyond its recent peak will depend on upcoming economic data and Fed policy signals.
DHF Capital asset manager Bas Kooijman said that for the dollar to keep climbing, the market may need to increase its bets on a 50‑basis‑point Fed hike.

He added that if Friday’s U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) comes in above expectations, or if Fed officials continue to issue hawkish remarks, Treasury yields could rise further, propelling the dollar past its recent high.
Conversely, weaker economic data or a cooling of expectations for large rate hikes could cause the dollar to give back some of its gains.
It is worth noting that the U.S. Treasury market was closed on Wednesday for the Veterans Day holiday.
Euro slips below 1.11 as French debt woes add pressure.
The strong dollar continues to weigh on other major currencies.

Since the start of the year, most G10 developed‑market currencies have depreciated against the dollar, except for the Australian dollar and the Norwegian krone, reflecting the widening interest‑rate differentials between the U.S. and other economies.
Some analysts also attribute this year’s dollar strength partly to safe‑haven flows that surged during the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran.
The euro, in particular, feels the pressure.
The euro fell 0.65% against the dollar overnight, breaking the 1.11‑dollar barrier and extending the decline from the previous session, reaching its lowest level since May 2025.
In addition to the strong dollar, France’s debt problems continue to drag the euro down, and falling oil prices have cooled market expectations for European Central Bank rate hikes.
Rabobank FX strategist Jane Foley said the ECB’s last press conference revealed growing concerns among the Governing Council about the economic‑growth outlook.

She added that another factor that could suppress the euro in the coming months is the political uncertainty surrounding next year’s French presidential election; a far‑right victory could affect the EU’s future cooperation direction.
Rabobank projects the euro will fall further to around 1.10 against the dollar within the next three months.
As expectations for Fed rate hikes keep rising, markets will closely watch U.S. inflation data and Fed officials’ remarks to gauge whether the dollar still has room to strengthen further.
